title: Mobile Game Data Collector – Remote, Hourly Pay, Paid Trial Available
description:
We are looking for a reliable freelancer to play mobile games through our browser-based platform and help us collect structured gameplay data. The work involves completing assigned gameplay sessions, progressing through mobile games, following task-specific instructions, and tagging important events during gameplay.



This is not a casual gaming role and is not primarily a bug-testing position. It is structured operational work that requires focus, consistency, accuracy, and a good understanding of mobile game progression and mechanics.



What You Will Do



Play assigned mobile games through our browser-based platform

Progress through levels, missions, and other game objectives

Follow written instructions and gameplay strategies for each task

Tag events such as level starts, wins, losses, popups, crashes, and other relevant moments

Track your progress and provide clear updates

Report technical or gameplay-related issues when necessary

Work consistently across multi-hour gameplay assignments



Requirements



Stable and reliable internet connection

A Windows or macOS computer

Good written English for understanding instructions and communicating progress

Strong attention to detail

Ability to stay focused during repetitive tasks

Reliability and consistent availability

Familiarity with mobile game progression, levels, rewards, currencies, and common game mechanics

Availability to work for at least several hours on active working days



Experience in one or more of the following is helpful, but not required:



* Mobile game testing or playtesting

* QA or manual testing

* Data annotation

* Content moderation

* Repetitive remote operational work

* Playing casual, puzzle, strategy, simulation, or free-to-play mobile games





Project Details



* Fully remote

* Flexible working hours

* Initial paid test task

* Approximately 20 hours of work for the first batch

* Potential for regular part-time or full-time work based on performance

* Consistent daily progress is expected while tasks are active





To Apply



Please start your message with the word "GAMEPLAY" so we know you read the full post, and include: your available hours per day, your computer's OS, and your internet speed.

title: Luxury Client Success Manager — Retention, Engagement & Experience
description:
Type of Work: Full-Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Starting Compensation: $1,500 per month

90-Day Compensation: Eligible to increase to $2,200 per month following a successful performance review and consistent achievement of KPIs



Job Overview



This is not a passive customer service role.



Bonding Biology Institute™ is seeking a highly organized, emotionally intelligent, and proactive Client Success Manager who will take full ownership of the client experience after enrollment.



Your primary responsibility is to ensure our clients feel seen, supported, valued, and actively engaged throughout their Love Success Journey™. You will monitor their progress, anticipate concerns, identify disengagement before it becomes a cancellation, and coordinate with our team to ensure each client receives an elevated, personalized experience.



Our clients should never have to disappear before we realize they needed support.



The right person will notice the silence, investigate the problem, take initiative, and follow through until it is resolved. You must be a self-starter who does not wait to be told what needs attention.



This role requires leadership, excellent judgment, meticulous tracking, emotional intelligence, and the ability to turn client information into decisive action.



Your Primary Mission



Your mission is to increase client engagement, satisfaction, retention, and long-term success by ensuring that every client:



- Receives a smooth and welcoming onboarding experience

- Understands what to do next in her journey

- Feels personally recognized and supported

- Remains engaged with classes, assignments, the app, and the community

- Receives proactive outreach when engagement declines

- Has concerns addressed thoroughly and promptly

- Experiences consistent follow-through from our team

- Continues progressing toward her desired transformation



Key Responsibilities



Own the Client Journey



- Oversee each client’s experience from enrollment through onboarding, participation, completion, renewal, or ascension

- Ensure every new client receives the correct welcome materials, agreements, login credentials, orientation information, schedules, and next steps

- Conduct proactive client check-ins at key milestones

- Make sure no client becomes lost, confused, inactive, or overlooked

- Maintain a clear understanding of where every client is in her journey



Track Client Health and Engagement



- Maintain an accurate client success dashboard or CRM

- Track onboarding completion, attendance, app activity, homework participation, community engagement, support requests, client sentiment, and progress

- Identify early warning signs such as missed classes, declining participation, unresolved concerns, negative feedback, or prolonged inactivity

- Create and execute recovery plans for at-risk or disengaged clients

- Document every important interaction, concern, action taken, responsible team member, deadline, and resolution



Increase Retention and Prevent Avoidable Cancellations



- Proactively contact clients who are becoming inactive or disconnected

- Determine the actual reason behind disengagement rather than accepting surface-level answers

- Help clients reconnect with their goals, program expectations, and next steps

- Coordinate additional support when appropriate

- Identify patterns that may be affecting retention and recommend solutions

- Support continuation, renewal, and ascension opportunities through excellent service and relationship-building



Create a Luxury Client Experience



- Ensure every interaction feels warm, polished, personal, responsive, and professional

- Learn relevant client details so communication does not feel generic or transactional

- Recognize progress, birthdays, milestones, wins, and meaningful breakthroughs

- Make clients feel remembered—not processed

- Handle sensitive situations with empathy, composure, discretion, and strong boundaries

- Escalate complaints, emotional concerns, billing matters, or high-priority situations promptly



Lead Cross-Functional Follow-Through



- Serve as the connection point between clients, coaches, community support, operations, billing, and the technical team

- Assign clear ownership when another team member must resolve an issue

- Follow up until the issue is fully resolved and the client has received confirmation

- Hold internal team members accountable for client-related deadlines

- Lead client experience meetings and present clear priorities, risks, and recommended actions

- Never assume that an issue is resolved simply because it was forwarded to someone else



Strengthen Community Engagement



- Welcome new members and help them feel connected immediately

- Encourage meaningful participation in classes, assignments, community conversations, and accountability activities

- Identify members who need encouragement, recognition, or additional support

- Help create conversations that make the community feel active, intimate, and transformational

- Monitor the emotional tone of the community and address concerns before they escalate

- Work with the team to reactivate inactive members



Reporting and Improvement



- Submit accurate daily and weekly client success reports

- Report what happened, what action was taken, what remains unresolved, who owns the next step, and when it will be completed

- Monitor retention, engagement, attendance, response times, client concerns, and reactivation results

- Gather client feedback and identify recurring gaps in the client journey

- Recommend practical improvements to systems, communication, onboarding, programming, and support

- Take initiative to improve the client experience without waiting for repeated instructions



This Role Is for Someone Who



- Is a natural leader and takes ownership without being micromanaged

- Is exceptionally thorough and notices details others miss

- Follows through completely—not halfway

- Can recognize a potential problem before it becomes a crisis

- Is emotionally intelligent, warm, nurturing, and professionally firm

- Communicates clearly by phone, video,
, text, and direct message

- Is comfortable speaking with sophisticated, high-achieving clients

- Can balance compassion with standards and accountability

- Makes decisions, proposes solutions, and takes appropriate action

- Keeps immaculate notes, records, deadlines, and follow-up systems

- Can manage multiple clients and priorities without allowing details to fall through the cracks

- Understands that activity is not the same as results

- Is dependable, responsive, resourceful, and solution-oriented



This Role Is Not for Someone Who



- Waits to be reminded about responsibilities

- Only responds when a client complains

- Forwards problems without confirming they were resolved

- Submits vague reports without names, details, outcomes, or next steps

- Needs constant direction to determine what should happen next

- Avoids difficult conversations

- Becomes overwhelmed by multiple priorities

- Treats client success as basic administrative support



Preferred Experience



- Client success, account management, customer experience, member retention, or community leadership

- Coaching, wellness, personal development, relationship education, luxury services, or high-ticket programs

- Managing a client journey from onboarding through completion or renewal

- Using CRMs, spreadsheets, project-management systems, membership platforms, or community apps

- Handling escalations, reactivating disengaged clients, and preventing cancellations

- Understanding emotional regulation, attachment styles, psychology, feminine energy, or relationship dynamics is a bonus



KPIs and Success Metrics



Performance will be measured by:



- Client retention and continuation rates

- Successful onboarding completion

- Class attendance and participation

- App and community engagement

- Reactivation of inactive clients

- At-risk clients successfully recovered

- Response and resolution times

- Client satisfaction and feedback

- Accuracy and completeness of CRM records

- Completion of proactive client check-ins

- Timeliness and quality of daily and weekly reports

- Reduction in unresolved client concerns

- Quality of leadership, initiative, and team follow-through



Compensation and Growth



Compensation begins at $1,500 per month for the first 90 days.



Following a successful 90-day performance review, compensation may increase to $2,200 per month based on:



- Consistent achievement of agreed-upon KPIs

- Demonstrated leadership and independent decision-making

- Accurate client tracking and reporting

- Strong client retention and engagement results

- Reliability, responsiveness, and complete follow-through

- Ability to identify and solve problems proactively



This position offers meaningful advancement opportunities for someone who becomes a trusted leader and consistently improves the client experience.



About Bonding Biology Institute™



Bonding Biology Institute™ is a luxury love mastery and relationship technology company founded by Shay Levister, also known as Shay Your Love Diva.



Through HerPocketCoach™, AI-powered support systems, Love Blocks®, the Five Love Archetypes™, and the 7-Stage Love Framework™, we help high-achieving women heal unhealthy relationship patterns, elevate their self-worth, and attract emotionally healthy, commitment-minded love.



We are building the future of relationship transformation through psychology, neuroscience, feminine embodiment, artificial intelligence, and structured emotional growth systems.



How to Apply



Please submit to 



- Your current resume

- A short video introducing yourself and explaining why you are an excellent fit

- A description of your client success, retention, community, or account-management experience

- An example of a time you identified and solved a client problem without being instructed

- An example of how you helped retain or reactivate a dissatisfied or disengaged client

- The systems or tools you have used to track client activity, follow-up, and outcomes



Please also respond to this scenario:



A client has missed two classes, has not logged into the app for 10 days, and says she has simply been busy. Explain exactly what you would do next, how you would communicate with her, what you would document, and how you would ensure the situation was fully resolved.



Please confirm if your able to work full time and exclusively for the company. 



Applications that do not include all requested materials will not be considered.

title: Real Estate Dispositions Manager (Remote) - US$6/hour + Commission
description:
We are hiring a Real Estate Dispositions Manager (fully remote). You will own dispositions end to end: taking a property from the moment it lands with us through to a signed assignment with a cash buyer, building the agent relationships that bring us deals, and managing the renovation work on the properties we keep.



This is a base plus commission role. Commission is paid on every deal you sell, and at a higher rate on deals you source yourself.



This is not a general admin VA role. Please read the three requirements below before applying.



REQUIRED, all three:

1) Prior dispositions experience in US real estate. You have personally moved wholesale contracts to cash buyers.

2) You have sourced deals through real estate agents. Specific properties that came to you through an agent relationship and went to contract.

3) You have project managed a rehab. At least one renovation you personally ran, including the scope, the budget, the contractors and the timeline.



You will be:

- Triaging every incoming deal within one business day

- Building and qualifying the buyer list, then presenting deals to named buyers by phone

- Building an agent network and sourcing deals through it

- Excellent, clear English, confident on the phone with US buyers, agents and contractors

Pay: US$6 per hour plus commission.



To apply, please reply with the following FIVE things:

3) One deal you got from a real estate agent, from the first conversation through to a signed contract.

5) How many years you have worked in US real estate, and confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

title: Instagram + Email Scriptwriter
description:
## About us



We are a coaching practice working with high achievers who might look like they have it all on the outside but feel privately stuck, stressed, anxious, unfulfilled, or disconnected.



Our work helps them come back to themselves and build a life that actually works across all the areas that count: mental and physical health, business, relationships, and lifestyle. Our approach is based on neuroscience, nervous system work, psychology, and ancient wisdom.



We are building this into something bigger. A practice, a body of work, and a community of people who want to live with more depth, clarity, and aliveness. The social media presence on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube is a core part of how we reach the people we are meant to work with.



We are looking for someone who feels drawn to this mission and wants to be part of building it with us. Experience or at least strong interest in the field of mental health, neuroscience, and/or nervous system work is a big plus.







Youtube: 



## The role



You will work closely with Patrice, Chloé and our content strategist as the person who writes everything that is part of our content: scripts for short-form (and later also long-form) video, carousels, text for b-roll posts, and captions. Patrice records every video himself, so the goal is that he can pick up your script and film it without changing a word.



Our strategist briefs you on what to write, Patrice records it, our video editor produces it. You own the words.



This is a role that starts at 10-20 hours per week and grows. We are ideally looking for someone who wants to grow into a larger role over time, in stages, as the business expands and as we get to know each other and both feel it is a good fit.



## What you will do



- **Write our instagram talking head scripts.** Text hook (unless already provided), spoken script and caption, based on briefs from our strategist and on voice notes where Patrice talks freely about a topic.

- **Write our carousels and the text for b-roll posts.** You write the words, our video editor does the design.

- Write
 marketing to promote our free offers or low-ticket offers.

- **Write in Patrice's voice.** Our writing guidelines are documented in detail, but the goal goes beyond following rules: it has to sound like Patrice speaking. Getting there will probably take time and a lot of feedback in the first weeks.



## What we are looking for



- Written English at near-native level and an ear for spoken language. Everything you write is either said out loud or put on screen as-is. Above all, you can write in someone else's voice and not only your own, and you follow a written style guide down to the detail. Matching Patrice's voice is the most important skill in this role.

- Excellent copywriting skills that converts. Hooks, captions, talking-head scripts with a real understanding of retention of viewers. You know the patterns that make people stop scrolling, and you know exactly how the first 3, 5 and 10 seconds have to be written to keep someone watching to the end.

- Strong logic and clarity. You can take messy spoken material, find the one clear idea inside it, and build it step by step in an order that makes sense to someone hearing it for the first time. Patrice gives you the substance, you put yourself in the listener's head and keep it easy to follow.

- Prior experience in the field of mental health, neuroscience, or nervous system work is a plus. Strong interest to really learn about this field is a requirement.

- Reliable with deadlines. The whole production chain waits on your scripts.

- You write it yourself. No AI-generated copy. We work with these tools every day and we recognise them immediately. If we wanted AI output, we would not be hiring a writer.



## Working setup



Fully remote, your own schedule mostly works. No strict overlap with Berlin (CET) time required, but we will likely have 1-2 weekly calls of 30-60 minutes.



## How to apply



No CV, no long application text, no LinkedIn is needed. Just send us the following.



*Note: Include the word “mango” in the title of your application otherwise your application will not be opened.*



We need to see:



- Examples of your work: scripts, captions, carousels, links to finished talking-head videos, your portfolio, whatever gives us the best feeling for how you write and who you have written for. If you have experience in the field of coaching or mental health, please make sure to include those examples.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

description:
Overview



We're a fast-growing headlamp brand, one of the biggest in our category and scaling hard into the US. Most of our buyers are women buying practical gifts for the men in their lives, and our creative is built around that gifting psychology.



⚠ Please read this overview in full before applying.



We're looking for a video editor who can take raw creator footage and turn it into a story that converts. Long-term role. Real growth path if you're an A-player.





Who We Need



Someone who genuinely lives in UGC and voiceover editing. Your real craft has to be storytelling with real people, real reactions, and real moments.



If you can take a folder of raw creator footage and d
 on your own which moments matter, which reactions carry the story, and how to pace it so it feels natural, you're who we need.



If you're stronger with heavy briefs telling you exactly which clip goes where, this role might not be the right fit for you. We'd love you to only apply if UGC storytelling is genuinely your strength.





The Bar We're Setting



- Real UGC editing experience with a portfolio of ads that ran on Meta or TikTok

- Storytelling instinct: you can find the story in raw footage without being told where it is

- Deep understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention for direct response ads

- Fluent TikTok-style captions that look natural, not editor-heavy

- Confident with ElevenLabs voiceovers, choosing natural voices, matching pacing

- Comfortable using AI tools (Higgsfield, Nano Banana) when a shot needs to be generated

- Understanding English well enough to read a script and know what it's really trying to say

- Reliable, communicative, takes feedback well, delivers on time

- 2 finished ads per day, Monday to Friday





What You'll Be Doing



- Editing UGC ads and voiceover ads (this is the core of the role)

- Some founder-style and mashup ads

- Occasional AI-assisted bottom-of-funnel and top-of-funnel work

- Reviewing our top-performing ads to understand why they work

- Working closely with the team on Slack to sharpen output every week





What This Pays



Base: $35 USD per finished ad.



The better the quality of your work, the better the opportunity for higher pay over time. Quality is what we reward here.





Growth Path



The editor who delivers through Q4 becomes a senior editor on the team in 2027. Real progression: more responsibility, higher rates, leadership of newer editors, direct collaboration on creative direction.





How to Apply



Apply through our form here: 



The form takes 10-15 minutes. Every editor we've hired who's done well on our team has filled this form out. It clearly works, so please take the time to show us your best answers and your best work.



If you're a strong fit, we'll come back to you with a paid test brief using real footage from the brand. Land the trial and you're cutting paid work within the week.



Thanks,

Jack

title: Supply Chain Manager - EU experience required
description:
Olvy sells through several European marketplaces, purchases from a fixed base of suppliers in China and works with external fulfilment partners. As the number of countries, channels and partners grows, so does the complexity of the supply chain.



The Supply Chain Manager holds end responsibility for the design and the performance of this chain. The role sets the inventory strategy, safeguards availability and inventory turnover, holds suppliers and fulfilment partners to measurable performance standards, and makes sure the supply chain remains scalable as we expand into new countries and sales channels.



The role carries independent authority, works against clearly defined KPIs, and takes over substantive ownership of the supply chain from the Operations Manager. This creates a single, clear owner for inventory, partner performance and the further development of the chain.



Responsibilities:

1. Inventory and planning

- Setting and maintaining safety stock and coverage targets per product category and per channel, based on demand

variability and actual lead times.

- Setting reorder points and replenishment logic, including MOQ and container constraints.

- Building and monthly updating of the long term forecast with a horizon of at least twelve months, including seasonal

peaks and deal periods.

- Determining the purchase quantity per order, subject to approval by the Operations Manager and, above the agreed

threshold, by finance.

- Monitoring inventory turnover and inventory health, and intervening actively in cases of overstock and slow movers.

- Directing the Supply Chain Coordinator on the weekly replenishment to the fulfilment channels.



2. Network and logistics

- Owning the performance of all fulfilment partners: defining SLAs, measuring them, reporting back monthly and escalating where needed.

- Selecting carriers and negotiating freight rates, covering sea and road freight and, where required, air and rail.

- Monitoring container utilisation and shipment consolidation, against a defined target for freight cost per unit sold.

- Preparing and executing the transition of the fulfilment network towards 2027, with the Operations Manager as decision maker.

- Designing the logistics chain when expanding into a new country or channel: storage, return flows, customs, the import process and VAT registration in cooperation with finance.



3. Supplier performance

- Structurally measuring suppliers on actual lead time, production capacity, delivery reliability and quality deviations.

- Holding periodic performance reviews with the key suppliers, at least quarterly, with recorded commitments and follow up.

- Negotiating prices, payment terms and incoterms with existing suppliers, subject to approval by the Operations Manager.

- Coordinating pre shipment quality inspections and following up on findings.



4. Performance and reporting

- Owning the supply chain KPIs in the internal dashboard: their definition, the reliability of the underlying data and their further improvement.

- Monthly reporting to the management team on availability, forecast accuracy, chain costs and risks, including a concrete proposal wherever there is a deviation.

- Owning escalations towards suppliers and fulfilment partners.

- Documenting and maintaining the working processes in the chain, so that execution does not depend on individuals.







***MUST HAVE/HARD REQUIREMENTS***

1. Five to ten years of supply chain experience, including at least two years with end responsibility for inventory norms or a fulfilment network.

2. Demonstrable experience with imports from Asia into Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning, customs and the import process.

3. Demonstrable experience managing external fulfilment partners on the basis of SLAs.

4. Inventory planning at parameter level, not purely executional. Able to explain why a norm is set where it is.

5. Strong analytical ability with data, able to work through large datasets and to question the output of a tool.

6. Experience in e-commerce or marketplace fulfilment.

7. Fluent English, both written and in negotiation.



Nice to have, not required

1. Lean Six Sigma or a comparable process improvement background.

2. Experience with EU product compliance and import regulations.

3. Experience building a supply chain rather than only managing an existing one.

title: Ecommerce Social Media & Creative Specialist
description:
Hello! We are a growing UK women’s ecommerce fashion brand looking for an experienced Ecommerce Social Media & Creative Specialist to take day-to-day ownership of our organic social content while also producing polished Canva creative, curating existing assets and supporting creative research.



This is a hands-on execution role. A large part of the role will involve working with existing assets - selecting the strongest content, adding or adapting text and graphic elements in Canva, recreating supplied creative references, producing variations, resizing assets and turning existing photography/UGC into polished social and ecommerce creative.



You do not need to be an advanced graphic designer or senior social strategist. However, you must have strong visual judgement, excellent Canva skills and ecommerce marketing experience.



What You’ll Own

====================

1. Organic Social Media

- Own the day-to-day content calendar across
, Instagram and TikTok.

- Select the strongest photography, UGC, creator content and finished video to use.

- Create, write, schedule and publish organic posts.

- Adapt and repurpose existing content appropriately for each platform.

- Create Stories, carousels, promotional posts, product-led posts, reviews, polls and other native social content.

- Write and adapt captions, hooks and calls to action.

- Keep our channels consistent, active, current and on-brand.

- Respond to comments and community activity, escalating customer-service issues where needed.

- Spot content that performs particularly well and share useful learnings with the team.



2. Canva & Ecommerce Creative

- Create polished social and ecommerce graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Add headlines, offers, reviews, prices, CTAs and other graphic elements to existing photography.

- Recreate supplied creative references using our own products, assets and branding.

- Create variations of existing successful creative.

- Produce product posts, Stories, carousels, promotional graphics, testimonial graphics and static Meta ad creative.

- Resize and adapt creative accurately for placements such as 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16.

- Maintain good typography, spacing, hierarchy and brand consistency.



This role is less about inventing complex designs from scratch and more about executing strong ecommerce creative quickly and to a high visual standard.



3. Asset Management & Creative Research

- Keep photography, UGC, creator content and finished creative organised and easy to find.

- Track which assets have already been used and identify strong content that can be repurposed.

- Identify content gaps and flag products lacking suitable photography, UGC, reviews or video.

- Research competitors, Meta Ad Library, Instagram and TikTok for relevant ideas, hooks, layouts and formats.

- Explain why an idea is interesting and how it could apply to our brand rather than simply saving examples.

- Share useful research with the Creative Strategist and founders.



Essential Experience

====================

- Previous professional experience working with an ecommerce/DTC brand or ecommerce clients.

- Experience managing social media for a brand, particularly
 and Instagram.

- Evidence that you have personally created posts, written captions and managed day-to-day social content.

- Strong Canva skills and the ability to produce polished ecommerce creative.

- Strong visual judgement and an understanding of what makes fashion/ecommerce content current and commercially useful.

- Comfortable recreating supplied reference designs accurately rather than needing to invent every concept yourself.

- Strong organisation across content calendars, assets and deadlines.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Able to work independently, follow creative direction and bring suggestions without constant supervision.

- Able to commit to approximately 35 hours per week as your primary role.



Strongly Preferred

====================

- Experience with fashion, apparel, activewear, beauty or another visually led consumer ecommerce brand.

- Experience creating content for a UK, US or Australian audience.

- Experience creating static
/Instagram ad creative.

- Meta Ad Library and creative-research experience.

- Strong Instagram,
 and 
 knowledge.

- Experience with social scheduling tools.

- Pinterest experience and basic Shopify familiarity.

- Basic understanding of ecommerce metrics such as CTR, CPA, CVR and ROAS.



The Person We’re Looking For

====================

- Visually strong: you can recognise which photograph, UGC clip or layout looks best and know when typography, spacing or cropping feels wrong.

- Commercially minded: you care about creative that gets attention and helps sell products, not simply content that looks pretty.

- Strong in Canva: you can recreate references, adapt templates, add polished text elements and produce accurate variations efficiently.

- Proactive and organised: you notice when content is running low, an asset is missing or something could be improved and act before being chased.

- Interested in fashion and ecommerce: you keep up with brands that are producing strong organic and paid-social creative.



How to Apply

====================

Please send:

1) Your CV, clearly highlighting the ecommerce brands or clients you have worked with.

2) Examples of social-media and Canva/ecommerce creative that you personally created, particularly promotional graphics, Stories, carousels, product content or static ads.

3) Name two ecommerce brands whose social or advertising creative you think is particularly strong. What do you like about them?

*** We also recommend creating a Loom video introducing yourself to stand out in the application process ***



Please include the word "alpaca" somewhere in your application so we know you have read the full job description.



Hiring Process

====================

Stage 1: CV, portfolio and relevant experience review.

Stage 2: Short practical assessment if shortlisted.

Stage 3: Video interview.

Final stage: Short paid trial before continuing if we’re all happy.

title: SENIOR BRAND, E-COMMERCE & MARKETING LEAD
description:
SENIOR BRAND, E-COMMERCE & MARKETING LEAD



Company: SUPR Global

Employment: Full-Time | Remote

Level: Senior / Leadership

Markets: Singapore, Malaysia & Asia



ABOUT SUPR



SUPR is a growing performance and lifestyle brand built for people who want more from their everyday performance — from training and sport to recovery and daily life.



We are building beyond individual products. Our goal is to build SUPR into a recognised performance brand across Asia.



As we scale, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Brand, E-Commerce & Marketing Lead who can take ownership of our brand, marketing and commercial growth.



This is not a position for someone who only executes campaigns, posts content or waits for instructions.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand the customer, build the brand, drive revenue, lead a team and execute at a high level.



You will work closely with the Founder/CEO and play a key leadership role in the growth of SUPR.



---



THE ROLE



You will own and oversee SUPR's overall brand, e-commerce, marketing and growth direction across Singapore, Malaysia and other Asian markets.



Your responsibility is not simply to generate awareness.



Your responsibility is to help turn brand attention into customers, customers into repeat customers, and SUPR into a scalable regional business.



You will be expected to develop the strategy, build the roadmap, lead the team, execute campaigns and continuously analyse what is working and what needs to change.



---



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. BRAND STRATEGY & MANAGEMENT



Own and strengthen SUPR's overall brand positioning, identity and direction.



You will:



- Develop and maintain clear brand positioning across products and markets

- Ensure consistent brand messaging, tone and visual direction

- Understand our target customers and what drives their purchasing decisions

- Develop strong product positioning and key selling propositions

- Identify opportunities to differentiate SUPR from competitors

- Lead campaign concepts and brand storytelling

- Ensure every customer touchpoint represents SUPR correctly

- Maintain consistency across website, marketplaces, social media, advertising, packaging, creators and campaigns

- Conduct competitor and market analysis

- Help shape SUPR into a recognisable and desirable performance brand



You should understand the difference between selling products and building a brand.



---



2. E-COMMERCE & REVENUE GROWTH



Take ownership of SUPR's e-commerce performance across:



Shopify

TikTok Shop

Shopee

Lazada

Future marketplaces and regional channels



You will:



- Develop strategies to increase online revenue

- Improve conversion rates

- Improve average order value (AOV)

- Develop bundles, upsells and cross-sells

- Optimise product pages and landing pages

- Improve merchandising and product positioning

- Plan marketplace campaigns and promotions

- Analyse customer purchasing behaviour

- Identify drop-off points in the customer journey

- Work on retention and repeat purchase strategies

- Improve the overall online customer experience

- Identify new sales channels and growth opportunities



You should understand how brand, creative, advertising, pricing, promotions and customer experience work together to generate revenue.



---



3. MARKETING & GROWTH STRATEGY



Develop and own SUPR's overall marketing and growth strategy.



You will:



- Build monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans

- Create a structured marketing calendar months ahead

- Develop customer acquisition and retention strategies

- Plan product launches and promotional campaigns

- Identify new growth opportunities

- Develop strategies for new market expansion

- Define marketing KPIs and targets

- Allocate marketing resources based on business priorities

- Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements

- Continuously test new channels, offers, messaging and audiences



We expect you to think beyond today's tasks.



You should know what the marketing team needs to be doing this week, next month and next quarter.



---



4. PERFORMANCE MARKETING



You should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, including:



- Meta Ads

- TikTok Ads

- Retargeting

- Paid social

- Creative testing

- Audience testing

- Landing page testing

- Conversion optimisation

- Campaign scaling



You do not necessarily need to personally operate every campaign forever, but you must understand performance marketing well enough to lead, evaluate and challenge the people responsible for it.



You should be comfortable analysing:



ROAS

CAC

CPA

CTR

CPC

CPM

Conversion Rate

AOV

LTV

Retention

Repeat Purchase Rate



You should be able to identify why performance is improving or declining and determine what the team should test next.



---



5. CAMPAIGN & PRODUCT LAUNCH MANAGEMENT



Own campaigns from idea to execution.



You will:



- Develop campaign concepts

- Build campaign timelines

- Coordinate product launches

- Plan promotional strategies

- Define offers and messaging

- Coordinate creative production

- Coordinate paid advertising

- Coordinate influencer and creator activation

- Coordinate e-commerce execution

- Ensure campaigns launch on time

- Monitor performance during campaigns

- Conduct post-campaign analysis



Every major campaign should have a clear objective, audience, strategy, timeline, owner, KPI and expected outcome.



---



6. CONTENT & CREATIVE DIRECTION



You will work closely with designers, video editors, content creators and external partners.



You should be able to:



- Develop strong creative directions

- Write clear creative briefs

- Identify strong hooks and marketing angles

- Understand what content performs across different platforms

- Evaluate creative quality

- Provide useful feedback to designers and editors

- Develop content pillars

- Balance brand-building content with conversion-focused content

- Identify trends without blindly following them

- Turn customer insights into creative concepts



You don't need to personally design everything.



But you must know what good creative looks like and why it works.



---



7. CREATOR, INFLUENCER & AFFILIATE MARKETING



Develop and scale SUPR's creator ecosystem.



This includes:



- Influencer partnerships

- Athlete partnerships

- UGC creators

- Product seeding

- Affiliate programs

- TikTok affiliates

- Brand ambassadors



You will:



- Identify suitable creators

- Develop creator strategies

- Build scalable outreach systems

- Structure affiliate campaigns

- Track creator performance

- Identify high-performing UGC

- Turn successful organic content into paid advertising opportunities

- Build long-term relationships with creators who genuinely fit SUPR



---



8. CUSTOMER RETENTION & CRM



Growth doesn't stop after the first purchase.



You will develop strategies around:



-
 marketing

- Customer segmentation

- Repeat purchases

- Product replenishment

- Customer lifecycle campaigns

- Abandoned carts

- Win-back campaigns

- Loyalty and community

- Cross-selling

- Customer feedback



Your objective is to increase customer lifetime value, not simply acquire more first-time customers.



---



9. TEAM LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT



This is a major part of the position.



You will lead and manage members across marketing, creative, content, e-commerce and other growth functions.



You will be expected to:



- Establish clear roles and responsibilities

- Set priorities and deadlines

- Assign ownership for projects

- Set KPIs

- Monitor team performance

- Conduct regular marketing and growth meetings

- Review progress and deliverables

- Hold team members accountable

- Identify blockers early

- Resolve execution problems

- Coach and develop team members

- Improve communication between departments

- Recruit or recommend additional talent when necessary

- Build efficient workflows and SOPs

- Ensure projects move forward without constant Founder/CEO intervention



The Founder should not need to constantly chase the marketing team for updates.



You should be capable of running the department, creating structure and making sure things get done.



---



10. REPORTING, ANALYTICS & FORECASTING



You will provide clear visibility into marketing and e-commerce performance.



You should be able to produce and explain:



- Weekly performance reports

- Monthly marketing reports

- Revenue performance

- Campaign performance

- Advertising performance

- Customer acquisition costs

- Channel performance

- E-commerce conversion

- Marketing spend

- Growth forecasts

- Upcoming campaigns and priorities



We don't want reports filled with numbers without meaning.



We want someone who can explain:



What happened?

Why did it happen?

What are we doing next?



---



ASIA & SINGAPORE MARKET EXPERIENCE



SUPR is building from Singapore with ambitions across Asia.



Therefore, previous experience working with Asian markets is highly advantageous.



Experience specifically within Singapore and/or Malaysia is a strong plus.



You should ideally understand:



- Singapore consumer behaviour

- Southeast Asian e-commerce

- TikTok Shop

- Shopee

- Lazada

- Regional purchasing behaviour

- Local promotional periods

- Regional creator/influencer ecosystems

- Mobile-first commerce

- Differences between Western and Asian consumer marketing



Candidates who have successfully grown brands within Singapore, Malaysia or Southeast Asia will have a strong advantage.



---



REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone with:



- 5+ years of strong experience in marketing, brand, growth or e-commerce

- Previous experience in a senior or leadership position

- Proven experience managing a marketing or growth team

- Strong e-commerce experience

- Strong understanding of Shopify

- Experience with TikTok Shop, Shopee and/or Lazada is highly advantageous

- Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok advertising

- Experience developing and executing marketing strategies

- Strong brand-building ability

- Strong understanding of DTC/customer acquisition

- Experience managing product launches

- Experience with creators, influencers and affiliates

- Strong analytical and commercial thinking

- Excellent project management

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment

- High level of ownership and accountability



Experience within sports, fitness, performance, wellness, nutrition, lifestyle, consumer products or DTC brands is highly advantageous.



---



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE



You are strategic, but you can execute.



You understand branding, but you also understand numbers.



You understand creative, but you also understand conversion.



You can manage people without needing someone else to manage you.



When something isn't working, you don't simply report the problem — you investigate it and propose what we should do next.



When sales decline, you want to understand why.



When a campaign performs well, you want to understand how to scale it.



When competitors move, you notice.



When there is an opportunity, you act.



You are comfortable working in a startup environment where things move quickly and priorities evolve.



Most importantly, you take ownership.



---



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- You need constant instructions before taking action

- Your experience is mainly social media posting

- You cannot confidently manage a team

- You struggle with deadlines and accountability

- You focus mainly on followers, likes and impressions instead of business outcomes

- You cannot understand marketing numbers

- You prefer maintaining existing systems rather than building and improving them

- You wait for management to identify every problem

- You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment



We are not hiring someone simply to manage marketing tasks.



We are hiring someone to help build the company.



---



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success means SUPR has:



A stronger and more recognisable brand.



A structured marketing engine.



Growing e-commerce revenue.



Profitable and scalable customer acquisition.



Better customer retention.



Successful product launches.



A clear marketing calendar.



Strong creative output.



A high-performing team.



Clear reporting and accountability.



And most importantly, a marketing department that can operate and grow without the Founder having to manage every detail.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your CV/resume

2. Portfolio or examples of brands you have worked with

3. Examples of campaigns you personally led

4. Actual measurable results you achieved

5. Examples of e-commerce businesses you helped grow

6. Team size and roles you previously managed

7. Platforms and advertising channels you have experience with

8. Experience working with Singapore, Malaysia or other Asian markets

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. Your availability/start date



Where possible, provide actual numbers such as:



Revenue growth

ROAS improvement

CAC reduction

Conversion improvement

E-commerce growth

Campaign revenue

Customer growth



Generic statements such as "I helped grow social media" will not be sufficient.



We want to understand what you personally did and what changed because of your work.



THE OPPORTUNITY



This is an opportunity to join SUPR at an early growth stage and play a major role in shaping where the brand goes next.



For the right person, this is more than another marketing job.



We are looking for someone who can become a key leader within SUPR and help build the brand across Asia.



BE SUPR.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:

title: Content & Influencer Manager - E-commerce
description:
Content & Influencer Manager

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines Preferred



MagicalButter is looking for an organized, proactive Content & Influencer Manager to manage and grow our creator partnerships.



You’ll own the day-to-day process from researching and contacting creators to coordinating content, tracking results, and checking commissions. This role combines relationship management, organization, and performance analysis.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Find relevant creators, influencers, and affiliates across TikTok, Instagram,

title: Virtual Assistant, SEO Delivery
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant who sits in every meeting, captures what was agreed, and then makes sure it actually happens. The core of this job is follow-up. You will chase internal team members and external clients until tasks are closed, and you will surface a blockage early rather than reporting it after the deadline has passed.



You need enough SEO knowledge to understand what is being chased and who owns it, and to ask a sensible clarifying question in the room rather than nodding along and getting it wrong later. Admin experience helps but is not a requirement.



Engagement Terms

- Part-time, remote, paid hourly or on a fixed monthly retainer.

- You attend all scheduled internal and client meetings.

- You must be available 30 minutes before and 30 minutes after every meeting. The before block is for prep: last meeting's notes, the open action list, and anything we owe the client that is late. The after block is for output: notes circulated same day and the first round of follow-ups sent immediately, not tomorrow.

- Meeting times follow the client, so many sit within Singapore hours but some will not. You need to be flexible outside a fixed daytime schedule.

- Once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star VA and cleared the interview, you will be added to a WhatsApp group and the relevant client Slack channels.



Key Responsibilities

- Meeting support

- Ask clarifying questions during the meeting when an action item is vague, unowned or undated.

- Prepare the pre-meeting brief in the 30 minutes before: agenda, open items and their current status, and anything overdue on our side.

- Circulate notes in the 30 minutes after, structured as decisions, action items with an owner and a date, and open questions.

Follow-up and chasing

- Follow up with internal stakeholders (writers, editors, SEO specialists, developers) on task status against the agreed dates.

- Follow up with external stakeholders (clients, client-side dev and marketing teams, guest post contacts) for approvals, website access, content sign-off, information and assets.

- Maintain one live tracker of every open item with owner, date requested, date promised, next chase date and status.

- Escalate to the account lead once a chase has failed twice, with a one-line summary of what is stuck and what it is blocking. Do not simply forward the
 thread.

- Flag risk in writing before a deadline is missed, not after.

- Admin support

- Calendar management, scheduling and rescheduling across the team.

- Maintaining trackers, folder structure and file naming in Google Drive.

- Formatting and tidying decks, reports and documents.

- Light data entry into Google Sheets and the project management tool.



Preferred Skills

- Working knowledge of SEO. You do not need to run campaigns, but you should understand on-page, off-page and technical -SEO, what a brief is, what a meta title does, and roughly why rankings take time.

- Confident, persistent follow-up. You are comfortable chasing people more senior than you and clients who have gone quiet.

- Excellent written English. Your notes and chase messages go directly to clients.

- Clear spoken English, since you will be asking questions live on client calls.

- Strong organisation. One tracker, kept current, with nothing held only in your head.

- Google Sheets: filters, sorting, conditional formatting. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP is a bonus.

- Familiarity with a project management tool (Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Monday or Notion).

- Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4 or Looker Studio, even at a viewing level.

description:
We’re an established DTC kids/family brand selling across the US and Europe, looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to take ownership of our Meta creative strategy.



We already have graphic designers, static ad designers and video editors ready to execute.



What we’re missing is the creative brain behind them.



Right now, the founder handles creative strategy. We’re looking for someone who can eventually take this off his plate and own the question:



What should we test next, and why?



WHAT YOU’LL DO



You’ll own the full creative strategy loop:



Research -> Insight -> Angle -> Concept -> Brief -> Launch -> Analyse -> Iterate



Your responsibilities will include:



* Researching customers, competitors, reviews, Reddit, Meta Ad Library, winning DTC brands and our own post-purchase survey data from real customers

* Turning real customer responses and voice-of-customer data into new desires, pain points, personas, hooks and untapped creative angles

* Developing creative concepts for Meta across statics, native ads, UGC, video and long-form ads

* Writing hooks, headlines, scripts, primary copy and clear creative briefs

* Giving our designers and editors clear direction on what to create and why

* Analysing creative performance and identifying why an ad won or lost

* Turning performance insights into the next round of creative tests

* Iterating winning angles and concepts instead of constantly starting from zero





WHAT YOU NEED TO UNDERSTAND



We’re looking for someone with real DTC/e-commerce and Meta advertising experience.



You should have a strong understanding of:



* Direct-response marketing

* Consumer psychology

* Customer awareness stages

* Funnel stages

* Market sophistication

* Voice-of-customer research

* Personas, desires, pain points and objections

* Angles, hooks, mechanisms and offers

* Creative testing and iteration

* Meta creative performance metrics

* Static, native, UGC, video and long-form advertising



You should understand that an unaware prospect needs different messaging from someone who is problem-aware, solution-aware or already product-aware, and be able to build creative strategy around those differences.



You should also understand how creative and messaging should change across different stages of the funnel.



And we want someone who stays on top of what is happening NOW:



* Meta advertising developments

* DTC creative strategy

* New ad formats and creative trends

* AI-assisted creative and research

* Changes in consumer behaviour

* New direct-response strategies and frameworks



We don’t want someone applying the exact same creative playbook they learned three years ago.





THIS IS NOT A DESIGNER OR VIDEO EDITOR ROLE



We already have the execution team.



You don’t need to spend your day in Photoshop, Canva, CapCut or Premiere.



Your job is to d
:



* What should we create?

* Who are we speaking to?

* What desire or problem are we targeting?

* What awareness stage are they in?

* What funnel stage are they in?

* What angle should we use?

* What should the hook be?

* Why should this concept work?

* What did we learn after testing it?

* What should we test next?



We don’t need more ads.



We need better creative decisions.





WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’ll probably be a great fit if:



* You’ve developed Meta creative strategy for DTC/e-commerce brands

* You can explain WHY an ad works, not just whether it performed

* You’re strong at customer research and can turn raw voice-of-customer data into non-obvious creative insights and angles

* You understand both creative psychology and performance data

* You can turn research into clear, executable creative briefs

* You can recognise winning patterns and build new iterations from them

* You actively follow the latest developments in Meta and performance marketing

* You have excellent written English

* You think independently and challenge your own assumptions with data

* You’re genuinely obsessed with advertising, psychology and why people buy





HOW TO APPLY



Don’t just send us a CV.



Send something that shows us HOW YOU THINK.



For example:



1. A creative brief you wrote and why you structured it that way



2. A Meta ad or concept you personally developed that you’d defend, including the strategy behind it



3. A winning creative you developed and any performance data you can share



4. A teardown of a Meta ad explaining the audience, awareness stage, angle, hook, psychology and why you believe it works



Please also include:



* Your portfolio

* Examples of DTC Meta ads you personally strategized

* Any performance results you can share (spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, revenue, etc.)

* Your exact role in those creatives

* Your expected monthly salary in USD



We care much more about how you THINK than how impressive your CV looks.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid creative strategy test.



We’re looking for someone long-term who can eventually take full ownership of creative strategy and become a key part of our growth team.

Sales

title: Finance Manager for a UK based advisory firm

Important

- Experience managing the finance function across multiple client accounts or entities at once, comfortable prioritising and moving between businesses of different sizes and complexity

- Genuine hands-on experience building management accounts and forecasts from scratch

- Comfortable producing forward-looking analysis and insight, not only reviewing and flagging issues in bookkeeping

title: Video Ad Editor for Meta and Instagram Ads (Long Term)
description:
Hi, nice to meet you!



We are a small team building a dog supplement brand for the US market. We love what we do, we move fast and we test a lot. Every week we run new video ads, all of them in English.



The concepts, scripts and raw clips are already done on our side. What we are missing is a good editor who turns that raw material into finished ads we can actually run. That is where you come in.



This is a long-term, ongoing role, not a one-off project. If it works well, there is a steady flow of work every week.



Your job in one sentence: you get raw clips, text and a written spec, sometimes explained in a short Loom video, and you deliver finished ads that are ready to run. When we want to try new ideas, we often work with references. Long term, you can also generate AI clips yourself using our frameworks.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Turn raw clips into finished, ready-to-run ads for Meta and Instagram

- Cut, time and assemble footage so it holds attention from the first second

- Add subtitles and on-screen elements

- Judge whether a clip is usable and clearly flag any video or sequence that is not

- Name every final upload exactly as specified (this is essential)



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Finished concepts and copy

- A written spec, or a Loom walkthrough

- References when we explore new ideas



WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

- To develop concepts

- To write or change copy



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Several years of experience editing video ads. Most of ours run 10 to 45 seconds, some may get longer

- Full understanding of Meta and Instagram safe zones. You know what gets cut in Feed, Stories and Reels, and you place things correctly without being told

- A sharp eye for faults in footage, AI-generated or real

- Good written English

- Reliable delivery times



We do not require a specific editing program. Use whatever you are fast in.



OUR TOOL STACK

Slack, Asana, Airtable and Google Drive. Nothing special, but we keep a clear structure and expect all files and statuses to stay tidy.



HOW WE START

If your application looks like a fit, we send you two example ads so you see exactly what we mean, and then we start with a small paid trial project.



WHAT YOU GET

- A long-term role with a steady flow of work every week

- Clear specs, finished copy and raw clips, so you can focus on editing

- Higher rates and more hours as we grow together

- Reliable payment, always on time



HOW WE START

If your application looks like a fit, we send you two example ads so you see exactly what we mean. Then we start with a small paid trial project. The trial does not guarantee an ongoing contract.



TERMS

- Around 5 to 10 hours per week to start, more later if it works well

- We work async. We are based in Europe (CET), no fixed hours needed

- Payment every two weeks via Payoneer (EasyPay) or Wise. If needed we can discuss another option as well.

- No agencies and no outsourcing. We want to work with you directly



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with "I am an editing expert" and include:

1. Links to 2 or 3 video ads you edited (Meta, Instagram or TikTok)

2. How many hours per week you can work for us

This is not a general administrative or data-entry position. You will work directly with construction documents, specifications, subcontractors, general contractors, pricing, bid requirements, and multiple active opportunities simultaneously.



The client typically has 6–10 active pursuits running in parallel, across multiple U.S. states, each with its own scope, documentation, subcontractors, and deadlines.



We are looking for someone with genuine construction estimating experience who can take ownership of the bid process with minimal supervision.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Monitor 
 and other U.S. procurement portals for relevant solicitations.

Track amendments, Q&A deadlines, site visits, and bid submission deadlines.

Review PWS, SOWs, specifications, drawings, and solicitation documents.

Extract scope requirements, forms, certifications, submittals, deadlines, and compliance requirements.

Identify required trades and subcontractors.

Research and source qualified subcontractors in the project geography, including unfamiliar markets.

Contact subcontractors by phone and
 to discuss scope and obtain pricing.

Communicate scope requirements, site requirements, payment terms, personnel requirements, and quote deadlines.

Collect, organize, compare, and evaluate subcontractor proposals.

Identify exclusions, scope gaps, pricing inconsistencies, and items requiring clarification.

Follow up persistently with subcontractors to obtain quotes before internal deadlines.

Prepare bid schedules, unit-price tables, and required government forms accurately and on time.



Phone outreach is a significant part of this position. You must be comfortable speaking directly with U.S. subcontractors and contractors.



General Contractor / GC Bids



The client also bids self-performed work directly to national and regional general contractors, including:



Post-construction cleaning

Rough and final cleaning

Interior and exterior glass

Pressure washing

Division 9 and Division 10 scopes

Related facility and finishing services



You will:



Monitor invitations to bid through
 and GC bid platforms.

Review ITBs, plans, specifications, and project schedules.

Identify the complete scope of work, including requirements located in other specification sections.

Complete GC bid forms accurately, including alternates, unit prices, allowances, sales tax treatment, bond and insurance requirements, union status, parking requirements, and project-specific exhibits.

Prepare and submit proposals to GC estimating and preconstruction contacts.

Confirm receipt of submitted bids.

Follow up consistently with GCs until the opportunity is awarded or closed.

Track bid-date changes, competitiveness, expected award timing, and feedback.

Maintain a live log of outstanding GC quotes, including project, GC, contact, value, submission date, last contact, next follow-up date, and status.

Support scope clarification and change-order documentation on awarded projects.



ESTIMATING & BID COORDINATION



Across both workstreams, you will:



Review lengthy construction documents and quickly identify critical requirements.

Extract and organize information from complex project documents.

Build and maintain multi-tab Excel pricing workbooks.

Use linked formulas properly rather than hardcoding values where formulas belong.

Verify that inputs flow correctly through dependent tabs before submission.

Maintain accurate estimating, bid, subcontractor, and quote records.

Manage multiple active bids and competing deadlines simultaneously.

Communicate professionally with subcontractors, vendors, GCs, contracting officers, and other stakeholders.

Use AI and other technology tools to improve document review, research, sourcing, and estimating workflows.



CONFIDENTIALITY & DOCUMENT CONTROL



Confidentiality is a non-negotiable requirement of this role.



You will be expected to:



Properly redact solicitation numbers, agency/end-client identities, and project-identifying information from documents before subcontractor outreach when required.

Ensure unredacted project details are released only when authorized.

Clearly identify documents as internal or external before sending them outside the company.

Ensure client-facing documents contain only approved billing information.

Never disclose internal cost data, margins, payroll information, or other confidential information to clients, GCs, or subcontractors.

Properly communicate and enforce non-circumvention requirements in subcontractor correspondence.



REMOTE WORK & HUBSTAFF



This is a fully remote position supporting a U.S.-based construction client.



Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work activity monitoring.



You must be comfortable working independently in a structured remote environment and maintaining consistent productivity during scheduled U.S. business hours.



You are expected to:



Accurately track working hours through Hubstaff.

Remain available during agreed working hours.

Maintain reliable communication with the client and team.

Respond promptly to time-sensitive bid and subcontractor matters.

Meet deadlines without constant follow-up.

Take ownership of assigned bids from start to finish.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of experience in construction estimating, bid coordination, construction procurement, or a closely related role.

Demonstrated experience reading and interpreting PWS, SOWs, specifications, plans, or other construction documents.

Hands-on experience sourcing subcontractors and discussing scope and pricing by phone.

Strong Excel skills, particularly multi-tab workbooks with linked formulas.

Strong spoken and written English.

Professional and confident phone presence.

Experience managing multiple bids, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong organization and follow-through.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Availability during U.S. business hours across multiple time zones.

Ability to make and receive calls through a U.S.-reachable phone number.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



The following are a strong advantage:



Experience with federal procurement and 
.

Familiarity with CLIN structures, set-asides, bid schedules, and wage determinations.

Knowledge of Service Contract Act (SCA) and Davis-Bacon requirements.

Experience with GC bid invitation platforms.

Experience with post-construction cleaning, Division 9/10 trades, or facility services.

Experience performing quantity takeoffs from drawings.

Familiarity with Bluebeam or construction estimating software.

Experience using AI tools for document review, research, sourcing, or estimating.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a construction professional who can hit the ground running.



You should be someone who:



Understands construction documents rather than simply processing them.

Can identify scope gaps and potential issues.

Is comfortable speaking directly with U.S. contractors and subcontractors.

Can source subcontractors in unfamiliar markets.

Can evaluate and normalize competing quotes.

Can manage several active bids without losing track of deadlines.

Follows up proactively instead of waiting for responses.

Takes ownership and keeps the bid pipeline moving.

Knows when to make a recommendation and when to escalate a decision.



If your experience is primarily administrative or data-entry based, this is not the right role.



If you have genuine construction estimating experience and enjoy the challenge of getting bids across the finish line, we want to hear from you.



SCOPE OF AUTHORITY



You will own the estimating and bid coordination process, but you will not have final authority over pricing or contractual commitments.



You will prepare, organize, analyze, and recommend, but you will not:



Set final pricing or margins.

Make final bid/no-bid decisions.

Sign or commit the company to a subcontractor, general contractor, or government agency.



The expectation is ownership of the process, not authority over the final number.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will be evaluated through practical work samples, not interview answers alone.



Candidates may be asked to complete:



1. Document Extraction Exercise



Given a 40–60 page PWS, produce a one-page summary within one hour identifying:



Scope

Required trades

Submittals and forms

Site visit date

Q&A deadline

Bid due date, time, and time zone



2. Subcontractor Outreach Exercise



Given a live solicitation, prepare the outreach package you would use to contact subcontractors.



3. Quote Normalization Exercise



Given three subcontractor quotes with different inclusions, exclusions, and units, prepare an apples-to-apples comparison and identify the questions you would send back to each subcontractor.



4. Live Call / Role Play



Participate in a short scope and pricing call to assess your communication skills and phone presence.



APPLICATION QUESTION



Please answer this question in your application:



Walk us through the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on. What was the project, what was your role, and what did you personally produce?



Please provide specific details about your hands-on work. Generic descriptions of your previous employer's responsibilities will not be sufficient.



READY TO TAKE OWNERSHIP OF THE BID PROCESS?



If you have real construction estimating experience, strong construction document skills, confidence communicating with U.S. contractors, and the ability to manage multiple bids independently, we'd like to hear from you.



To apply:



Complete the application form.

Upload your updated CV.

Submit your short introduction video.

Answer the application question about the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on.



Please be specific about your hands-on experience. We are looking for someone who has actually worked on construction bids—not someone who has only provided general administrative support.

title: Customer Support Manager – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience end to end, not just the tickets that come your way. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring a manager to run point on resolution quality, the AI workflow behind it, and the processes and sheets the team runs on.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket you touch, catch what the process and the AI miss, and then fix the process itself so it stops happening. This is a hands-on managerial role, not a hands-off one. You'll work tickets yourself, and you'll turn what you see in them into concrete fixes for the AI agent, the sheets, and the workflows the rest of the team depends on.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



* What You'll Own

* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice, for you or anyone else working the queue.

* The processes and sheets support runs on. Tighten what's inefficient, fix what's broken, and keep everything current as the business changes.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 3+ years in e-commerce customer support manager position, with a specific example of a process, sheet, or workflow you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role, and it definitely isn't the role if you're the one expected to write the checklist for others.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Monday to Friday, (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break).



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved, or whether the process behind it got better.

* You believe every order or tracking detail needs a human double-check before it reaches a customer, no matter what the AI already verified.



How We Hire



1. This application takes real thought, and that's on purpose. Low-effort or AI-generated answers won't advance, and we respect your time enough to tell you that up front.

2. Answer our application questions properly.

3. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

4. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview on experience and fit.

5. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

6. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



Full-Time Perks (after a 1 to 2 month probation)



* 13th-month pay

* 18+ days of paid time off

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

* Health insurance (HMO)

* An annual training and learning budget

* The option to fly out and meet the rest of the team

REQUIREMENTS

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE

WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential
