title: DATA ENTRY SPECIALIST
description:
Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



ABOUT US

We are a growing U.S.-based exterior remodeling company helping homeowners improve, maintain, and protect their homes.



Our services include roofing, siding, windows, gutters, and other exterior home improvement projects. We are committed to providing quality service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and creating efficient systems that allow our team to deliver an excellent customer experience.



As our company continues to grow, we are building a reliable remote team to support our day-to-day operations.



We value accuracy, accountability, professionalism, teamwork, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic. We are looking for people who want to learn, contribute, and grow with the company over the long term.



We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented, and organized Data Entry Specialist to join our growing team.



The primary responsibility of this position is to ensure that our business information is entered accurately, updated regularly, properly organized, and easy for our team to access.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, spreadsheets, CRM systems, and repetitive tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.



We are looking for someone who takes their work seriously and understands that accurate data is critical to a successful business.



📋 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Your daily responsibilities may include:



Entering customer and project information into our systems.

Updating and maintaining CRM records.

Entering information into spreadsheets and databases.

Reviewing data for accuracy and completeness.

Identifying and correcting data-entry errors.

Updating customer contact information.

Organizing and maintaining digital records.

Transferring information between systems.

Processing forms, documents, and other business information.

Maintaining accurate customer and project records.

Checking for duplicate or incomplete information.

Performing regular data quality checks.

Updating project and customer statuses.

Organizing spreadsheets and digital files.

Assisting with basic reports and data preparation.

Performing online research when information is missing.

Keeping records organized and up to date.

Following company procedures for data entry and documentation.

Handling customer and company information confidentially.

Completing assigned tasks accurately and on time.

Assisting with other administrative tasks when needed.

🔍 ACCURACY COMES FIRST

We are looking for someone who understands that quality is more important than simply entering data quickly.



You should be comfortable:



Double-checking your work.

Verifying information before submitting it.

Following instructions carefully.

Maintaining consistent formatting.

Identifying missing information.

Catching errors before they create problems.

Keeping records clean and organized.

If you naturally notice small mistakes that other people miss, you'll be a great fit for this position.



⚡ SPEED + ACCURACY

You should be able to work efficiently without sacrificing accuracy.



We value someone who can:



Work through large amounts of information.

Stay focused on repetitive tasks.

Maintain consistent productivity.

Meet daily and weekly deadlines.

Prioritize urgent tasks.

Maintain a high level of accuracy throughout the day.

💻 TOOLS & SOFTWARE

Experience with the following is preferred:



Google Sheets

Google Docs

Google Workspace

Microsoft Excel

Gmail

CRM systems

Customer databases

Cloud-based software

File management systems

Data management platforms

Canva

ChatGPT / AI tools

You don't need experience with every tool.



What matters most is that you are comfortable using computers and able to learn new software quickly.



⭐ THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

We are looking for someone who is:



🔍 Detail-oriented — You care about accuracy and check your work.

🗂️ Organized — You keep information and files structured.

⚡ Efficient — You can work quickly while maintaining quality.

🚀 Proactive — You don't ignore problems or missing information.

💻 Tech-savvy — You are comfortable learning new systems.

🎯 Reliable — You consistently meet deadlines.

🧠 Focused — You can stay productive during repetitive work.

🤝 Professional — You communicate clearly with the team.

📈 Willing to learn — You are interested in improving your skills.

🎯 REQUIREMENTS

Previous data entry, administrative, or virtual assistant experience preferred.

Strong written English.

Good computer skills.

Strong attention to detail.

Good typing and data-entry skills.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets.

Basic knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel.

Ability to follow instructions accurately.

Ability to work independently.

Strong organizational skills.

Good time management.

Ability to meet deadlines.

Reliable internet connection.

Reliable computer.

Quiet and professional workspace.

Availability during agreed-upon U.S. business hours.

🏡 INDUSTRY EXPERIENCE IS A PLUS

Experience in any of the following industries is helpful:



Exterior remodeling

Roofing

Construction

Home improvement

Windows

Siding

Gutters

Real estate

Property management

Insurance restoration

Home services

You frequently make careless mistakes.

You struggle to stay focused.

You need constant supervision.

You frequently miss deadlines.

You are uncomfortable working with spreadsheets.

You don't enjoy working with data.

You are unwilling to learn new software.

🏠 100% Remote Work

💼 Long-Term Employment Opportunity

📚 Training and Support

# AI Video Production Assistant / AI Content Creator



We are looking for an **AI Video Production Assistant** to help create high-quality AI-generated videos for social media and marketing.



You will work with scripts, reference images, and creative direction to generate scenes, maintain character consistency, iterate on generations, and help assemble finished videos.



## What You'll Do



* Create AI-generated images and videos from scripts and references

* Maintain consistent characters, clothing, environments, and visual styles

* Generate reference images and turn them into video scenes

* Adjust prompts and regenerate scenes when something is wrong

* Break complicated scenes into smaller generations when needed

* Organize video assets and generated clips

* Perform basic video editing and assemble scenes

* Help test and improve our AI video workflow



## Tools We Use



We work with tools such as:



* Higgsfield

* Seedance / Seedance 2.5

* Kling

* AI image-generation tools

* CapCut or similar editing software



**Previous experience with these tools, or similar AI image/video generation tools, is a strong plus.**



We are especially interested in candidates who already understand AI video generation, prompting, reference images, character consistency, and how to iterate when a generation does not come out correctly.



## What We're Looking For



* Strong attention to detail

* Good visual judgment

* Experience with AI video or image generation

* Ability to follow detailed creative direction

* Comfortable experimenting and regenerating scenes until they are right

* Basic video editing ability

* Fast learner who is comfortable with new AI tools

* Organized and reliable

* Strong written English communication



This is not a role where you generate a scene once and submit whatever the AI produces. We care about quality, consistency, and being able to recognize and fix problems.

* A short introduction

* Your portfolio or examples of relevant work

* Any AI video/image tools and video editing software you have experience with



**AI-generated video examples are strongly preferred.**



We are looking for someone we can work with long-term and gradually give more ownership over the full AI video production process.

title: SEO & SEM Specialist
description:
SEO & SEM Specialist



Location: Remote, working with a Singapore-based team  



Employment type: Full-time, 44 hours per week / 176 hours per month  



Working hours: Monday to Friday, 1:00pm to 9:00pm Singapore time  



Reporting to: Senior SEO Manager and CEO  



Experience required: 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience. Singapore education, tuition or local-service experience is strongly preferred.



About Achievers Dream

- Achievers Dream is a Singapore Chemistry and Science tuition specialist. The centre supports Primary Science students and students taking O-Level, IP and JC H1/H2 Chemistry, with centres at Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan. Its growth focus is clear: help more parents discover the right programme, book a diagnostic consultation or trial, and receive a thoughtful follow-up experience.



Role overview

- The SEO & SEM Specialist will own the search roadmap for Achievers Dream. This is a hands-on role covering technical SEO, local SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), content optimisation, Google Ads, landing-page conversion and performance reporting.



You will work closely with the management, content and web teams to make sure Achievers Dream is visible when Singapore parents search for Primary Science tuition, PSLE Science tuition, O-Level Chemistry tuition, JC H2 Chemistry tuition, Chemistry practical tuition and local tuition options near its centres.



The role is not just about traffic or clicks. It is about building a reliable search engine that produces qualified parent enquiries, trial bookings and measurable learning-programme demand.



What you will do



SEO strategy and execution

- Build and maintain an SEO roadmap for Achievers Dream's core programmes: Primary Science, PSLE Science, Lower Secondary Science, O-Level Chemistry, IP Chemistry, JC H1/H2 Chemistry and Chemistry practical lessons.

- Carry out keyword research, search-intent mapping and competitor analysis for the Singapore tuition market.

- Optimise service pages, location pages, resource hubs, blog content, titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and calls to action.

- Improve local SEO visibility for Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan, including Google Business Profile hygiene, location-page content and review signals.

- Work with the web team on technical SEO: crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, redirects, canonicals, structured data, mobile UX and site migrations.

- Build content briefs that help parents and students, while improving eligibility for search results and AI-assisted search experiences.

- Own GEO and AEO improvements so Achievers Dream is easier to understand, cite and recommend across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other answer engines, using clear entity information, helpful FAQs, structured content and accurate on-page proof.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, indexed pages, technical issues and AI-search visibility; translate findings into a prioritised monthly action plan.



Google Ads and paid-search performance

- Build, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for Achievers Dream's programmes and locations.

- Structure campaigns by intent and level, for example: Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC H2 Chemistry, Chemistry Lab and local branch terms.

- Write and test search ads, assets, landing-page messages, audience signals, keyword match types and negative-keyword lists.

- Improve qualified leads by monitoring search terms, conversion quality, cost per lead, cost per booked trial and campaign-level performance.

- Run disciplined A/B tests across ads, landing pages, offers,- forms, calls to action and bidding strategies.

- Coordinate retargeting and paid social support where it is part of the approved campaign plan.

- Protect budget quality by excluding irrelevant searches such as free notes, tutor jobs, answer keys and non-target education levels where appropriate.



Analytics, reporting and conversion tracking

- Maintain reliable tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and lead or trial-booking forms.

- Define and report the conversion journey from click to enquiry, booked trial, attendance and enrolment where CRM data is available.

- Build a simple monthly dashboard for management covering organic visibility, paid spend, qualified enquiries, cost per lead, conversion rate, booked trials and key actions taken.

- Diagnose drops or anomalies before making recommendations; clearly distinguish confirmed first-party results from platform estimates.

- Use Ahrefs, Google Ads Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio and crawling tools to guide decisions.



Collaboration and ownership

- Work directly with management, teachers, content writers and developers to turn search insights into better pages, campaigns and parent journeys.

- Maintain a clear backlog of SEO, SEM, content and technical actions, including owner, priority, expected impact and validation method.

- Keep up with Google Ads policy changes, search algorithm updates, local-search behaviour and AI-assisted search trends.

- Bring practical recommendations, not just reports. Explain what should change, why it matters, who owns it and how success will be measured.



What we are looking for



Required

- 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience.

- Proven ability to manage search campaigns that generate leads, not just clicks.

- Strong technical SEO knowledge: site architecture, redirects, canonicals, indexation, page speed, Core Web Vitals, schema and internal linking.

- Strong Google Ads experience across search campaigns, keyword strategy, bidding, search-term analysis, conversion tracking and landing-page optimisation.

- Comfort using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Ahrefs, Looker Studio and spreadsheet-based analysis.

- Strong written English and the ability to write clear, parent-friendly search ads, briefs and reporting summaries.

- Analytical discipline: can explain the difference between a ranking, a click, an enquiry, a booked trial and an enrolled student.

- Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently in a remote team.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in Singapore local SEO, education, tuition, enrichment, healthcare or another parent-led local-service market.

- Experience optimising Google Business Profiles and multi-location local search.

- Experience working with WordPress, Astro or another modern CMS.

- Familiarity with CRM or lead-management workflows and offline conversion tracking.

- Experience producing or briefing educational content for Primary, PSLE, O-Level or JC audiences.

- Experience with GEO, AEO, AI-search visibility, entity optimisation or structured content for answer engines.



First 90 days

| Period | Focus | Expected output |

| Days 1 to 30 | Audit and foundation | Access and tracking review, SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads audit, keyword map, priority opportunity list, lead-quality baseline and 90-day execution plan. |

| Days 31 to 60 | Launch and optimise | Rebuilt or improved campaign structure, negative-keyword controls, priority landing-page improvements, local SEO actions and first content or technical tickets shipped. |

| Days 61 to 90 | Scale what works | Documented test learnings, conversion-quality review, a prioritised next-quarter roadmap and a management dashboard with agreed reporting definitions. |



KPIs for success



KPIs will be agreed after access, tracking and baseline data are verified. Likely measures include:

- Growth in qualified parent enquiries and booked trials from organic and paid search.

- Improvement in cost per qualified lead and cost per booked trial, where tracking is reliable.

- Visibility and ranking progress for agreed commercial keywords across Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC Chemistry and local branch terms.

- Organic clicks, impressions and conversion contribution from Google Search Console and GA4.

- Google Ads search-term quality, click-through rate, conversion rate and budget efficiency.

- Completion of agreed technical, content and landing-page priorities.

- Clear monthly reporting with recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.



Application process



Before submitting your resume, please include a concise 90-day draft plan for how you would improve Achievers Dream's SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads performance. This can be a one- to two-page document. We are looking for clear priorities, practical actions and how you would measure progress, not a generic proposal.



Please submit:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. Your 90-day draft plan, submitted together with your resume.

3. A short summary of one SEO project and one Google Ads project you personally improved.

4. A sample dashboard, report or case study, with sensitive client data removed.

5. A short response to this question: How would you approach improving qualified trial bookings for a Singapore Primary Science and Chemistry tuition centre in your first 90 days?



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid practical assessment based on an anonymised Achievers Dream landing page or Google Ads account scenario.

title: Personal Assistant to the Founder (start in Customer Service) — Australian fashion brand
description:
Hamilton Island Boutique is an Australian women's fashion brand, founder-led and growing. We are preparing to scale over the coming months, with more markets and a second store planned. You will work directly with the founder.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS



This is a Personal Assistant role. You will become the founder's right hand: the person who runs day-to-day operations, keeps an overview of everything that happens in the business, and reports to the founder. We train you into that role through customer service, because that is where you learn the business, the customers and the supplier. We begin with a few hours per week, and your hours and responsibilities grow as the work grows: from customer service into disputes, supplier follow-up, admin, and eventually running operations.



We are not looking for someone who answers
s. We are looking for someone who understands that the job of customer service is to keep revenue inside the company and to protect the reputation of the brand, and who genuinely cares about the result.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Handle customer
s and messages in our internal dashboard.

- Handle refund requests the right way: find out what the customer actually needs and offer a real solution before a refund is ever on the table.

- Handle payment disputes and chargebacks: gather the facts, respond, and resolve them in the company's favour.

- Follow up with our supplier on orders that need attention.

- Report to the founder at the end of every shift.

- As you grow: listing checks, admin, keeping our procedures up to date, and more responsibility as the company expands.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU



- At least 1 year of customer service for a Shopify or dropshipping store, including refunds and disputes.

- You have handled PayPal or card disputes before and you know how to win them.

- Excellent written English: clear, warm, and written for the person in front of you, not copied from a template.

- You ask when you are not sure instead of guessing.

- You are structured and reliable: nothing gets forgotten, and you report without being reminded.

- You are comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your work.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Part-time to start, growing into more hours as the business grows.

- Hourly pay that grows with your responsibilities, plus bonuses tied to results. The more revenue you keep inside the company and the better things run, the more room there is for bonuses and raises. We reward good work.

- Direct line to the founder, proper training, and a clear path to running operations.

- A brand that is about to scale, with a second store on the way.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word BOUTIQUE on the first line, then answer these five questions. Applications that skip a question will not be read.



1. Describe a case where a customer demanded a full refund and you kept the sale. What exactly did you offer, and what was the result?

2. A customer opens a PayPal dispute for "item not received", but the tracking shows it was delivered. What do you do, step by step?

3. Which Shopify stores have you worked for, for how long, and what did you handle there?

4. Why should we NOT hire you?

5. Your earliest start date and the hours you are available per day.



Everything you see in this role stays inside the company.
salary: $3.50/hour, growing as you take on more

Kosta Homes (trading as Costa Lux Living, S.L.) is a boutique short-term rental management and property sales company based on the Costa del Sol, Spain. . As we scale, we're looking for a sharp, reliable Virtual Assistant to become the front line of our guest experience and the day-to-day link between our team and our co-hosting property owners.



**The Role**

You'll own guest communication and day-to-day coordination across our portfolio, working closely with our Málaga-based team. This is a hands-on, guest-facing role — not a back-office data-entry position — for someone who is calm under pressure, writes excellent English, and already knows the vacation rental tech stack.



**What You'll Do**

• Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries and messages across Airbnb, 
 and our Hostaway unified inbox — pre-booking questions, check-in/check-out details, house rules and local recommendations.

• Chase every upcoming guest to make sure their 
 ID verification/registration is completed before arrival, following up until it's done.

• Audit our 15 listings on a seasonal basis (Summer vs. Winter) and propose concrete changes — photos, descriptions, amenities highlighted, minimum-stay rules, pricing strategy — to keep each listing optimized for the time of year.

• Keep listings, calendars and rates synced and accurate across Hostaway, Airbnb and 
.

• Support pricing and calendar management in PriceLabs, flagging rate or occupancy opportunities.

• Monitor and respond to guest reviews, and help maintain our high review-score portfolio.

• Keep clear records of guest interactions, escalations and recurring issues for the management team.



**Must-Have Experience**

• Prior experience as a Virtual Assistant supporting a vacation rental / short-term rental business (Airbnb co-hosting, property management company, or similar).

• Hands-on working experience with Hostaway (or a comparable PMS/unified-inbox tool), plus Airbnb and 
 host/extranet tools.

• Working experience with PriceLabs.

• Excellent written English — clear, warm and professional guest communication is non-negotiable.

• Comfortable managing multiple WhatsApp groups and conversations simultaneously without dropping details.

• Spanish language capability: some of our co-hosting clients are Spanish and communicate in Spanish in their WhatsApp group. You must either speak/write Spanish yourself, or be fully comfortable and accurate using online translation tools (e.g. Google Translate, DeepL) to read and respond in Spanish professionally.

• Previous experience working with European or Spanish hosts/clients.

• An eye for seasonal hospitality trends — what makes a summer beach-town listing vs. a winter listing convert better.

This role requires availability during Spanish business hours (Madrid time, CET/CEST), roughly 9:00–18:00 Spain time. title: Senior Customer Support Specialist – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience, don't just answer tickets. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring someone to run point on resolution quality and the AI workflow behind it.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket, catch what the process and the AI miss, and treat the customer experience like it's yours. This is an individual contributor role, not a task-only one. Do it well and a bigger one opens up.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



What You'll Own



* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates to you: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 2+ years in e-commerce customer support, with a specific example of something you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM (Next day) Manila time (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break). Rest days Sunday to Monday.



Not for You If



* You see this as "just a job."

* You need step-by-step direction and go quiet when something's off.

* You hand over problems instead of solving them.

* You measure yourself by ticket count instead of whether the customer's actual problem got solved.

* You believe every order or tracking detail needs a human double-check before it reaches a customer, no matter what the AI already verified.



How We Hire

This application takes real thought, and that's on purpose. Low-effort or AI-generated answers won't advance, and we respect your time enough to tell you that up front.



1. Answer our application questions properly.

2. We respond to every applicant. No ghosting.

3. Qualified applicants complete a short first interview on experience and fit.

4. Those who pass complete a short technical interview.

5. Crush it, and we send you an offer.



Full-Time Perks (after a 1 to 2 month probation)



* 13th-month pay

* 18+ days of paid time off

* Every AI tool you need, paid for by us

title: Web Developer & AI Automation Specialist
description:
Hula is Life is a small US-based team building websites for clients. We’re looking for someone who knows how to build a website that looks good, works well, and is easy to use—and who’s comfortable using AI to help get it done.

You should have solid experience with web coding or website building, know your way around Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT, and be able to connect tools and automate tasks using Make or n8n.



What you’ll work on

- Build, update, and troubleshoot client websites.

- Turn ideas and designs into responsive pages that work across desktop and mobile.

- Use AI tools to help write, improve, and debug code, with enough technical knowledge to check the results.

- Build automations that connect websites, forms, and business tools.

- Troubleshoot broken integrations and keep everything running smoothly.



What we’re looking for

Hands-on experience building websites, whether through code, website builders, or a mix of both. You should be comfortable with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and able to explain how you built something and why.



We’d also like someone who has:

- Practical experience with Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT beyond basic prompting.

- Experience building working automations in Make or n8n.

- Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and connecting different platforms.

- Clear written English, reliable internet, and their own computer.

- The ability to work independently and ask questions when something needs clarification.



Experience with Go High Level is a plus, since that’s where we run many of our client websites.



Hours and setup

Hours are flexible, and most of our team works Philippine hours. We’d like some overlap so we can collaborate. This is part-time to start, with room to grow into full-time as the team grows.



How to apply

Use the exact phrase Addy Sent Me in your subject line, and include:

- Your resume.

- Your portfolio and links to websites you’ve built. Tell us what you personally worked on.

- A short example of an automation you built using Make or n8n: what it does and which tools it connects.

- How you use Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT in your actual workflow.

- Your preferred working hours, weekly availability, and expected hourly rate.



We care about what you can build and how you solve problems. Show us your work and give us an honest picture of your experience—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Full-Time WFH Account Manager (Client Retention) — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

REQUIREMENTS

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE

WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF

title: Image Ad Creator with Winning Swipe Research Experience
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a fast-growing health, beauty, and wellness ecommerce company running Meta ads across multiple international markets.



We are looking for an experienced Image Ad Creator who can produce high-quality static ads and find strong competitor swipes. This is not a general graphic-design position. You must understand direct-response advertising and be able to explain why an ad concept is worth testing.



Your main responsibility will be creating static image ads for
 and Instagram. Strong swipe-research experience is highly preferred because we want someone who can identify promising concepts and turn them into original ad variations, rather than waiting for every idea to be provided.



You will work closely with a Creative Strategist and receive feedback based on creative testing, media-buying results, and Meta compliance.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Create static image ads for ecommerce products across health, beauty, wellness, and personal-care categories.

- Research competitor ads using the Meta Ad Library and other approved sources.

- Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, layouts, audience problems, and visual concepts.

- Evaluate swipes using available evidence such as reach, run duration, repeated concepts, active creative volume, market relevance, and product fit.

- Turn approved swipes and creative briefs into original ads without directly copying competitors.

- Create variations using different hooks, angles, offers, layouts, and visual approaches.

- Produce advertorial, testimonial, product-benefit, comparison, offer, and problem-solution ads.

- Use AI tools when appropriate to create or improve product scenes, backgrounds, models, and other creative elements.

- Correct AI-generated problems involving hands, faces, text, labels, lighting, shadows, and product accuracy.

- Follow every brief carefully and confirm the correct product, market, offer, copy, and claims before submission.

- Organize source links, swipe references, working files, and final creatives clearly.

- Revise ads based on strategist feedback, performance results, and rejected-ad learnings.

- Flag risky health claims, misleading visuals, or unclear instructions before proceeding.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven experience creating static Meta ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands.

- A portfolio containing relevant ecommerce image ads.

- Strong direct-response design skills, including visual hierarchy, typography, readability, layout, and product presentation.

- Experience using the Meta Ad Library and researching competitor ads.

- Ability to explain why a swipe may be working based on evidence, not only appearance.

- Ability to preserve the core idea behind a swipe while creating an original ad.

- Proficiency in Canva and Photoshop. Figma experience is a plus.

- Practical experience with AI image-generation or editing tools is preferred.

- Strong attention to product names, labels, offers, markets, claims, and brief requirements.

- Reliable communication and the ability to complete revisions professionally.

- Full-time, long-term availability.

- Weekend availability when required.



META COMPLIANCE EXPECTATIONS



You must recognize and avoid risky elements such as:



- Cure, treatment, or medical claims.

- Guaranteed results.

- Unrealistic timelines.

- Misleading before-and-after concepts.

- Aggressive personal-attribute language.

- Unsupported authority or doctor claims.

- Celebrity or television-personality lookalikes.

- Offers or discounts that do not match the approved brief.



If a brief or swipe contains a risky claim or visual, stop and ask the Creative Strategist for clarification before creating or submitting the ad.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word SWIPE.



Answer all questions below. General applications that do not answer the questions will not be prioritized.



1. How many years have you created static image ads for ecommerce, dropshipping, or DTC brands?

2. Which health, beauty, wellness, supplement, or personal-care products have you worked on?

3. Walk us through how you find strong competitor ads using the Meta Ad Library or other sources.

4. What evidence do you use to d
 whether a swipe or concept is worth testing?

5. Share one example of a competitor swipe and the original ad you created from it. Explain what you changed.

6. How do you preserve the main reason a swipe works without copying the competitor directly?

7. Which design and AI tools do you use?

8. Describe one ad where you used AI. Explain what you generated and what you corrected manually.

9. How many high-quality static-ad variations can you normally produce per day?

10. What health or beauty claims and visual concepts would make you stop and request a compliance review?

11. Share your CV and portfolio. Prioritize ecommerce static ads, swipe boards, source links, AI-assisted creatives, and performance results where available.

12. State your availability, weekend availability, earliest possible start date, and expected monthly salary in USD.



Qualified applicants may be invited to complete an Image Ad Creator test task after the initial screening.

title: Social Media Content Creator – Women’s Pole Dancing Studios
description:
We’re looking for a creative, proactive Social Media Content Creator to help manage the social media content for our two women-only pole dancing studios in Australia.



This is an ongoing part-time role, initially around 5 hours per week, with the potential for the role to grow.

Our studios are fun, supportive, empowering and a little bit sassy. We want our social media to reflect that — fun, confident, sexy, welcoming and real, rather than corporate or generic.



The role

We already have plenty of great students, instructors, classes and raw content.

What we need is someone who can take much more ownership of the thinking, planning and creation behind our social media.

We don’t want to have to come up with every Reel idea ourselves and then simply hand footage over to be edited. We want someone who can research what’s working, spot trends, come up with ideas and present us with great options.

We will choose the ideas that feel fun, suitable for our brand and realistic for us to film. You can then tell us what footage you need, we’ll film it, and you can take it from there.



What you’ll be doing

• Researching Instagram and TikTok for current trends, sounds, Reel formats and content ideas

• Finding trending ideas that could be adapted creatively for our pole dancing studios

• Coming up with original content ideas

• Presenting us with ideas to choose from rather than waiting for us to tell you what to create

• Providing simple instructions for what we need to film once an idea is approved

• Reviewing our raw footage and identifying the best clips

• Editing engaging Reels and short-form videos

• Selecting photos for posts

• Writing captions and on-screen text that suit our personality

It's a varied and unusual business, which means no two weeks are quite the same. We sell items from the properties through our large local

There will sometimes be time-sensitive
 activity when we're selling items from a property, so some flexibility is important. On occasion, this may involve scheduled evening work responding to
 
.



Over time, I'd like this role to expand beyond marketing and into broader operational support as you learn the businesses and become increasingly familiar with how we work.



AI will be an important part of how we work together



I already work extensively with ChatGPT and use AI throughout my business to help with marketing, planning, systems, communication and improving our processes.



I'm looking for someone who is already a confident and regular user of AI tools and, ideally, can bring additional knowledge and ideas to the table.



I see this as a collaborative relationship between me, you and AI. I want you to actively look for opportunities where AI or technology could make our work faster or more efficient. If we can automate or streamline part of your workload, that's a positive — it gives you more capacity to take on other valuable responsibilities as the role grows.



I'd like to work with someone who:

Has excellent written and spoken English

Has strong professional experience with Canva

Has strong experience using
/Meta for business and marketing

Is confident learning new software and digital tools

Has a positive, friendly and communicative personality



Experience with GoHighLevel would be helpful but isn't essential if you're confident learning new software.



Most importantly, I'm hoping to find someone who genuinely wants a long-term position and the opportunity to become an increasingly valuable part of our team as the businesses continue to grow.



Hours & availability



The role will initially be approximately 10 hours per week until early November, while we get to know each other, begin training and I have some upcoming travel.



From approximately mid-November, I'll be back in the office and expect the role to increase to around 20–30 hours per week. I'm looking for someone who has the capacity and availability for this to become their primary role, without being stretched too thin across multiple other clients.



I'd like to have one to two regular video catch-ups each week, generally around 7:30–8:00am Philippine time / 9:30–10:00am Cairns time. Monday will usually be our main weekly catch-up, with a second catch-up generally on either Thursday or Friday when needed.

Pay

We'll have a formal performance and pay review after three months, with opportunities for the role, responsibilities and remuneration to continue growing over time.

title: Editor
description:
## Role Overview



We are looking for skilled editors who can generate an article from our brief using AI and then edit it into something a real reader would finish and a client would be proud to publish. You are not a writer and you will not be starting from a blank page.



You own the piece from generation through to the final version. You will work across client industries, currently weighted towards healthcare, with expansion into finance and other verticals.



This is not proofreading. Grammar and spelling are the floor, not the job. The hard part is the human factor. AI will hand you something fluent, confident and completely generic, and your job is to turn that into something that reads like a person who knows the subject wrote it. The finished article has to answer what the reader actually searched for, say something the first three Google results do not, and carry none of the tells that make a reader stop trusting the page.



## Engagement Terms



* Article requirements will be assigned based on the client deliverables and content calendar.

* You will generally not be required to attend client meetings. After meetings, the relevant article requirements and briefs will be passed to you by the team.

* The exact number of articles may vary depending on client deliverables and workload rather than being a fixed number every month.

* You will be given the client's style guide, SEO brief and target keyword for each piece.

* The team/VA will handle coordination with the relevant stakeholders, including assigning articles, following up on requirements and managing the back-and-forth around approvals and publication.

* If the workload becomes too much for one editor, additional freelance support may be brought in to help with generating initial drafts or earlier rounds of editing. The editor remains responsible for the final review and overall quality of the piece.



## Key Responsibilities



### Writing quality



* Generate the first draft from our brief, target keyword and the SERP competitors using AI. Prompt it with the brief, the competitor pages and the client's existing copy rather than a one-line instruction. The raw output is your starting point, never your deliverable.

* Strip the AI tells before anyone else sees it: uniform paragraph lengths, em dashes, empty openers, hedged claims, lists with nothing specific in them, and confident statements with no source behind them.

* Ensure the text is free from grammar, spelling and punctuation errors.

* Keep the language user-friendly and concise. Cut filler. If you apply for the role, use **I'm your star editor** as your subject line.

* Match the client's house voice, including US or UK spelling as instructed per client.



### Reader experience



* Make the article logical and credible by using supporting evidence where relevant, such as statistics, academic publications, case studies, testimonials, Google reviews and relevant endorsements.

* Create a sense of assurance and connection. Use the PEEL structure (Point, Elaboration, Example, Link) where appropriate while keeping the writing authentic and relatable.

* Highlight and sharpen the client's unique selling points so the piece does not read like every competitor's page.



### SEO checks



* Confirm the draft answers the search intent behind the target keyword. If the ranking pages are comparisons and our draft is a sales page, flag it.

* Ensure the target keyword is present in the H1, the first 100 words, the meta title and two or three H2s where appropriate, placed naturally and never stuffed.

* Check that the meta title and meta description are within length, with the keyword front-loaded and used naturally.

* Maintain the correct heading hierarchy with no skipped levels.

* Add internal links to relevant service pages using descriptive anchor text.

* Flag missing or unsourced claims and any section that is too thin to stand.



### Business and compliance



* Place calls to action strategically, for example after treatments, after benefits and after the "why choose us" section, rather than relying on one block at the end.

* For healthcare clients, ensure the copy complies with the Healthcare Services (Advertisement) Regulations. Flag superlatives, guarantees, comparative claims and testimonials that cannot stand.



## Preferred Skills



* Minimum 1 year of editing experience. Agency or content-marketing experience preferred.

* Working knowledge of SEO. Deep technical SEO is a bonus, not a requirement.

* Able to drive AI tools well (ChatGPT, Claude or similar), and more importantly able to tell when the output is generic and fix it.

* Comfortable working from a brief and style guide without hand-holding.

* Excellent written English, native or near-native fluency.

* Able to switch between US and UK spelling on instruction.

* Bonus: healthcare or finance content experience.



## How to Apply



Please attach your CV and two published pieces you edited, and name one of them you are still proud of.



Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: AI Creative Engineer (Storytelling & UGC Video) - No graveyard shift
description:
#About the scope

Make short-form video that sells: UGC-style ads, product stories and social content for our own products and for the brands we work with. The difference is that we build most of it with AI. The on-camera talent, the voice, the B-roll, sometimes the whole scene, is generated, then edited so it feels native to TikTok, Reels and Meta feeds. We are a small, hands-on team based on Singapore time, and this role is the person who actually makes the videos.



#Why this one's interesting

Most "AI video" looks like AI video. Yours should not. The job is to take a brief, find the story inside it, and turn it into a 15 to 60 second piece that stops the scroll and makes someone want the product. You get to work across the whole stack: writing the hook, designing the look, generating the talent and scenes, cutting the edit, and then reading the numbers and doing it again, better. The tools change every month. You will be the person who knows which one to reach for.



#What you'll own

Writing hooks and short scripts built on direct-response structure (hook, problem, product, proof, call to action). Generating AI avatars, voiceover and lip-sync with tools like HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Arcads or Captions, and keeping a consistent bench of characters per brand. Building scenes, product shots and B-roll with image and video models such as Kling, Veo, Runway, Midjourney or Flux. Graphic design for thumbnails, overlays, captions and static ad variants. Editing in CapCut, Premiere or DaVinci Resolve to a native, platform-ready finish. Shipping variations (hook, avatar, angle, format) for testing, then reading Meta and TikTok results to d
 what to iterate. Keeping the asset library tidy and named so anyone can find and reuse a script, character or clip.



#Portfolio (required, please read)

We will not review applications without work samples. Send us three to five short-form videos you made yourself. For each, tell us which parts were AI-generated and which tools you used. We care about the hook and the storytelling more than production polish. If you have made at least one UGC-style ad with an AI avatar or AI B-roll, lead with that.



#What we're looking for

Hands-on with at least two AI video, image or voice tools and comfortable learning a new one in a weekend. A storyteller first: you can explain why a video worked, not just how you made it. Real editing skill in CapCut, Premiere or Resolve, with a good ear for pacing and sound. Solid graphic design fundamentals: type, layout, colour, a feel for what looks native on each platform. Good written English for scripts and captions. Comfortable with volume, you would rather ship ten strong videos a week than one perfect one a month. Basic ad literacy: you know what hook rate, CTR and ROAS mean and can read a dashboard. Fluent with AI as a professional tool. Claude especially, or a capable equivalent like ChatGPT. We mean using it to build and produce: drafting script variants, structuring prompts for video models, writing the small scripts and automations that speed up your pipeline. If you currently only use it to chat, that is fine, but we are looking for someone who uses it to ship. Self-directed, this is remote and contract, so you run your own process and hit deadlines without hand-holding. Prefer availability 9am to 6pm Philippine time.



#Nice to have

Motion graphics in After Effects or similar. Prompt engineering experience for image and video models. Experience on e-commerce, DTC, app or SaaS ad accounts. Familiarity with creative-testing frameworks and naming conventions in paid social. Dubbing or localisation workflows. Any Python, n8n or Make automation experience.



#The engagement

Type: Freelance / independent contract, ongoing. Location: fully remote, we work on Singapore time (UTC+8), so a Philippine day lines up with ours. Same hours, no graveyard shifts. Pay: in PHP, paid reliably on schedule via Wise or PayPal. Scope: ongoing production with weekly targets. Rate: tell us yours. Start: soon.



#What's in it for you

Hours that fit your life. A budget for the AI tools you need. Direct access to the performance data, so you see what your work does. A small English-speaking team that respects your craft and will not micro-manage. Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale.



#How to apply

Send four things, keep it short: links to three to five videos you made, with a note on which parts were AI and which tools (required); one new 15 to 30 second UGC-style ad for any product you like, made with AI talent, this is the main thing we judge; two lines on the best-performing piece of content you have made and why it worked; your rate and availability. No long cover letter needed.

title: Technical SEO Developer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Technical SEO Developer who can implement SEO changes directly, not just recommend them.



This role is for someone comfortable working inside CMS files, templates, and codebases to improve crawlability, performance, and keyword rankings. If your experience is mainly content SEO, reporting, or tool-based optimization, this role will not be a good fit.



What You Will Do

 • Audit and implement technical SEO fixes related to:

 • Crawlability and indexation

 • Site architecture and internal linking

 • Canonicalization and rendering issues

 • Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile performance

 • Work directly within:

 • WordPress (themes, plugins, core files)

 • Shopify (Liquid templates, SEO constraints, performance)

 • PHP-based platforms (e.g. OpenCart or similar)

 • Implement structured data and technical enhancements at code level

 • Optimize websites for traditional search and AI-driven search experiences (GEO / GSEO)

 • Take ownership of ranking performance and SEO KPIs

 • Use SEO tools to diagnose issues, but rely on implementation, not automation alone



Required Skills & Experience

 • 3+ years of hands-on technical SEO implementation

 • Comfortable editing live websites and templates

 • Working knowledge of:

 • HTML, CSS, JavaScript (rendering understanding required)

 • PHP and Shopify Liquid

 • Experience working directly inside:

 • WordPress, Shopify, and PHP-based e-commerce platforms

 • Strong understanding of:

 • Google Search Console

 • Ahrefs / Semrush

 • Screaming Frog, Lighthouse, GTmetrix

 • Able to clearly explain why SEO actions are taken and how they affect rankings

 • Good command of spoken and written English



Nice to Have

 • Experience with SQL or Python / Node.js for SEO automation

 • Practical exposure to Generative Engine Optimization (GEO / AI search)

 • Proven examples of technical changes leading to ranking improvements



Important Notes

 • This is not a strategy-only or reporting-only role

 • Candidates who rely mainly on plugins, widgets, or third-party apps without understanding the underlying technical mechanics will not be suitable

 • You must be comfortable implementing changes yourself

title: Business Operations Manager
description:
Business Operations Manager

Part-Time | Remote | £7.50 per hour



About the Role

We are recruiting on behalf of a growing UK-based Plumbing, Heating & Renewable Energy company seeking an experienced and proactive Business Operations Manager to help improve and manage the back-end operations of the business.

The company is also in the early stages of developing a Real Estate business, creating an opportunity for the successful candidate to grow their responsibilities as both businesses develop.



This is not a traditional administrative role.

We are looking for someone with strong business operations experience who can come into an established business, understand how it currently operates, identify inefficiencies and take ownership of implementing better systems, processes and ways of working.



Rather than waiting for tasks to be delegated, you should be comfortable saying:



“Here’s what I think we can improve, here’s how I recommend we do it, and I can take ownership of making it happen.”

The initial focus will be the Plumbing, Heating & Renewable Energy business, with involvement in the Real Estate business increasing over time.



Working Hours

Monday – Friday

10:00am – 2:00pm UK Time

5:00pm – 9:00pm Philippines Time



20 hours per week

£7.50 per hour



Key Responsibilities



Business Operations & Process Improvement

Review existing business operations and identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks and areas for improvement

Develop and implement more efficient administrative systems and processes

Take ownership of back-office operations and help ensure the business runs smoothly

Create structured workflows for recurring business activities

Reduce the Director’s involvement in routine operational tasks

Identify opportunities to improve productivity and efficiency

Help build an operational structure capable of supporting future growth

Proactively recommend better ways of working rather than simply following existing processes



Systems, Workflows & SOPs

Review how information and tasks currently move through the business

Develop clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

Improve internal documentation and record keeping

Build repeatable processes for recurring activities

Ensure processes are documented clearly so they can be followed by other team members

Identify gaps where systems or processes are currently reliant on the Director

Help introduce greater consistency and accountability across operations



Customer & CRM Management

Improve how customer enquiries are recorded and managed

Develop processes for customer follow-ups

Maintain accurate CRM and customer records

Improve visibility over outstanding enquiries, actions and follow-ups

Identify opportunities to improve the overall customer journey

Ensure important tasks and enquiries don't fall through the cracks



AI, Technology & Automation

Identify repetitive or manual tasks that could potentially be automated

Explore practical ways AI and technology can improve day-to-day operations

Use modern AI tools, including platforms such as Claude, to improve productivity

Recommend tools and systems where they could improve efficiency

Help implement straightforward automations and AI-assisted workflows within your level of expertise

Work with external automation specialists where more advanced technical builds are required



Note: You are not expected to be an advanced AI developer or automation engineer. We are looking for someone who understands how AI and automation can improve a business and can identify where these technologies could be effectively implemented.



Administrative & Operational Support

Alongside improving processes, you will be comfortable getting involved in the day-to-day operation of the business where required.



This could include:

Organising documentation and business records

Managing operational tasks and follow-ups

Maintaining internal systems

Coordinating workflows

Supporting customer administration

Managing recurring back-office activities

Supporting the Director with operational priorities

This is a hands-on role. You should be equally comfortable improving a process and then taking ownership of operating that process.



Real Estate Business Support

As the company's Real Estate business develops, you will gradually help establish the operational foundations required to support it.



This may include:

Developing administrative processes

Creating workflows and SOPs

Organising documentation

Supporting CRM and customer management

Implementing systems from the outset

Helping ensure the new business is built with scalable processes in place



Essential Skills & Experience

Strong previous experience in business operations, operations management or a similar role

Proven experience improving business processes and workflows

Experience creating and implementing SOPs

Strong administrative and organisational skills

Experience managing CRM systems and customer processes

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

Able to identify problems and recommend solutions without waiting for instruction

Confident learning and implementing new technology

Strong attention to detail

Able to manage multiple priorities effectively



Highly Desirable

Previous experience supporting a UK-based business

Experience working within Plumbing, Heating, Renewables, Construction or another trades/service-based business

Experience working in an Operations Manager or Business Operations role

Experience implementing or improving CRM systems

Experience using AI tools such as Claude

Familiarity with workflow automation

Experience supporting a growing or owner-managed SME

Property or Real Estate experience



What We’re Looking For

We want someone who:

Takes genuine ownership of their responsibilities

Looks for solutions rather than waiting for instructions

Naturally spots inefficient ways of working

Enjoys creating structure from disorganised processes

Can challenge existing ways of doing things constructively

Thinks commercially about how a business operates

Is comfortable introducing new ideas to the Director

Can turn an idea into a documented, repeatable process

Understands when technology can solve a problem — and when it can't

Is both strategic and hands-on

Wants to become an important long-term member of a growing business



What This Role Isn’t

Not basic data entry

Not simply completing tasks from a daily checklist

Not waiting for the Director to tell you what to do next

Not purely administrative support

Not an advanced AI development position

Not suitable for someone without previous experience taking ownership of business processes

We are specifically looking for someone who can bring experience, ideas and initiative into the business.



How to Apply

Use “Vixa Hire” in the subject line of your application.



Please submit:



Your CV

A short cover letter explaining why this role interests you

Examples of processes, systems or SOPs you have previously created or improved

Details of any Operations Manager / Business Operations experience

Details of your experience with AI, automation and CRM systems

Details of any experience working with UK service-based, trades, property or construction businesses

Your internet speed test result

A screenshot of your laptop/PC specifications



In your application, please also briefly answer:



“What is one business process you have improved in a previous role, what was wrong with it, and what did you change?”



We’re looking for an experienced operator who can become a trusted part of the business, bring structure to the back-end operation and help build the systems needed to support its next stage of growth.

title: Video Editor
description:
We are looking for a talented, reliable Video Editor to turn our video podcasts into polished, professional long-form episodes and engaging short-form social media content.



This role is ideal for someone who understands both podcast storytelling and the fast-paced editing style needed for high-performing Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and other social content.

About the Role



You will edit video podcast episodes from raw footage into complete, polished productions. This includes creating compelling hooks, intros and outros, lower thirds, motion graphics, captions, transitions, B-roll, sound design, and other visual elements that make the content professional and enjoyable to watch.



You will also identify the strongest moments from each podcast and turn them into short, engaging video clips designed for social media. In addition to podcast content, you may be asked to edit other videos such as promotional content, educational videos, interviews, ads, and behind-the-scenes content.



Key Responsibilities:

Edit full-length video podcast episodes into polished, professional productions.

Create strong opening hooks that retain viewer attention.

Add branded intros, outros, lower thirds, titles, captions, transitions, and graphics.

Source and incorporate relevant B-roll, stock footage, sound effects, music, and visual assets where appropriate.

Improve audio quality, pacing, colour, framing, and overall production value.

Create engaging short-form clips from podcast episodes for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts,
, and LinkedIn.

Edit reels with dynamic captions, punch-ins, motion graphics, visual effects, B-roll, and strong pacing.

Help identify podcast moments with strong potential for social reach and audience engagement.

Edit other marketing and content videos as needed.

Organise project files and deliver exports in the correct formats, sizes, and aspect ratios.

Work from brand guidelines and incorporate feedback efficiently.



What We’re Looking For:



Proven experience editing podcasts, interviews, talking-head videos, or social-media content.

Strong understanding of short-form video formats and viewer-retention techniques.

Ability to create visually engaging content without making it feel over-edited or distracting.

Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar professional editing software.

Strong skills in captions, motion graphics, lower thirds, transitions, sound design, and colour correction.

Ability to source appropriate B-roll, graphics, music, and stock footage.

Excellent attention to detail, especially with audio syncing, subtitles, spelling, branding, and pacing.

Good English communication skills and the ability to understand feedback clearly.

Reliable turnaround times and strong file/project organisation.

Ability to work independently while proactively suggesting creative ideas.



Nice to Have:



Experience editing content for entrepreneurs, business owners, coaches, creators, or personal brands.

Basic graphic design or motion-graphics skills.

Experience creating thumbnails, quote graphics, or simple social-media assets.

Familiarity with YouTube optimisation and social-media trends.

title: Customer Support & Admin Specialist (Canadian Client Services)
description:
Shift: Permanent Night Shift (Mon–Fri, 40 hrs/week)

Total Package: PHP 52,300 / month



ABOUT WINSLOW PACIFIC

Winslow Pacific runs the back office for trade contractors across Vancouver Island, British Columbia. From roofers to plumbers, we answer their calls, book their appointments, and keep their schedules organized so they can stay focused on their work.



We’re a registered Canadian startup with a tight-knit, fully remote team. We're looking for a dependable, articulate team member to serve as the voice and main administrative point of contact for a small portfolio of our trade clients.



THE ROLE

When a homeowner’s roof is leaking or their well pump stops working, you’re the calm, steady voice on the line.



You’ll answer inbound calls for a few dedicated contracting companies. To the customer calling in, you aren't an outsourced center - you're a seamless part of that contractor's office. Building and maintaining that trust is central to everything we do.



Your day-to-day responsibilities:

- Handle inbound calls: Light-to-moderate volume (starting around 15 to 20 calls a day).

- Manage schedules & follow-ups: Book appointments, confirm estimates, and handle callback promises promptly.

- Take accurate messages: Capture full, clear details and route them quickly to the right person.

- Provide exceptional customer care: Callers are often stressed about home repairs. Your warmth, patience, and clear communication set their minds at ease.

- Use quiet hours productively: Learn our clients' services, familiarize yourself with Vancouver Island geography (towns, drive times, local names), and help with executive admin tasks (inbox management, calendars, research, data entry) as requested by the Founder



WORK SHIFT & SCHEDULE

Hours: Monday to Friday, 11:00 PM – 7:00 AM Manila Time (8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Pacific Time).

Status: 40 hours/week, permanent night shift.



This is a permanent graveyard role, so we want to be upfront about the hours. If night shifts fit your current routine and lifestyle, we’d love to hear from you.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



Clear, Warm Communicator: You speak fluent, easy-to-understand English with natural phrasing and feel confident speaking with North American customers.



Meticulous & Reliable: You notice the small details and follow through on every task. In trade services, an unpassed message can cost a contractor a major job.



Self-Disciplined: You work well independently without needing someone watching over your shoulder.



Tech-Comfortable: You adapt quickly to modern cloud tools and software.



Bonus Points: Prior experience working in Jobber and answering calls for North American clients is a plus. Background in home services/trades (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, well drilling) is an even bigger plus.



REQUIREMENTS



- A modern, capable computer or laptop

- A reliable, wired noise-canceling headset

- A quiet, private workspace free from background noise

- High-speed internet with a concrete backup plan for power/internet interruptions

- A working webcam (used for team and client video check-ins)



Exclusive commitment: This is a full-time, dedicated position. We ask that your scheduled shift hours are strictly reserved for Winslow Pacific.



COMPENSATION & BENEFITS



Total Monthly Package: PHP 52,300

- Base Pay: PHP 42,200

- Night Differential: PHP 3,570

- HMO / Health Allowance: PHP 2,000

- Remote Work Allowance: PHP 4,530 for internet/equipment needs



Additional Perks:



- Weekly Payouts: Paid every week via Wise - no waiting until the end of the month.

- 13th Month Pay: PHP 42,200 (paid early December).

- Paid Canadian Holidays: 11 BC statutory holidays per year.

- Paid Leave: 4% PTO accrual (approx. 10 paid days off per year).

- Birthday Off: Paid day off on your birthday.

- Performance Bonuses: Bonuses tied to personal and company achievements.

- Career Growth: Long-term stability with a company that prefers promoting from within.



HOW TO APPLY

To confirm you've read the full posting, please start your application with the word ISLAND.



Please send us:



A short introduction: A brief paragraph about yourself and why a permanent night shift fits your current schedule.



A 60–90 second voice recording or loom video (file or link): Introduce yourself, then briefly role-play answering the phone for a company called "Coastline Roofing" and taking a message from a homeowner dealing with a roof leak. (We're listening for natural warmth, tone, and clarity - not perfection!)



Your updated resume



Note: We review every application that includes these three items, but we cannot move forward without a voice recording or loom video.

description:
Part-Time | Remote / Work From Home | Automotive Industry



About MMM Auto Centre



MMM Auto Centre is a family-owned and operated automotive business with over 20 years of industry experience.



Based in Melbourne’s northern suburbs, we specialise in quality used auto parts and vehicle dismantling, supplying parts to trade customers, repairers and the general public across Australia.



As our business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Auto Parts Pricing Specialist to join our remote team on a part-time basis.



About the Role



The Auto Parts Pricing Specialist will be responsible for researching, assessing and setting competitive prices across our used auto parts inventory.



The ideal candidate will have strong automotive knowledge, an understanding of used parts values and the ability to research the market to ensure our pricing remains competitive while protecting our margins.



Key Responsibilities



* Research and establish pricing for used automotive parts

* Assess parts based on make, model, year, condition, availability and market demand

* Research current market pricing across online marketplaces and competing suppliers

* Compare OEM, aftermarket and used part pricing

* Review and update existing part prices when required

* Identify opportunities to improve margins and pricing accuracy

* Ensure pricing is commercially competitive

* Research OEM part numbers and vehicle compatibility where required

* Assist with pricing newly dismantled vehicles and incoming inventory

* Maintain accurate pricing information within our systems

* Monitor market trends and adjust pricing accordingly



About You



* Strong automotive parts knowledge

* Previous experience in auto parts pricing, parts interpreting, dismantling or automotive sales

* Good understanding of OEM, aftermarket and used parts

* Strong knowledge of vehicle makes, models and parts

* Confident researching market pricing and demand

* Excellent attention to detail

* Commercially minded with an understanding of sales and profit margins

* Able to work independently in a remote environment

* Strong computer and research skills

* Pinnacle experience highly preferred

* Automotive industry experience is essential



What We Offer



* Part-time remote work-from-home position

* Flexible working environment

* Ongoing position with an established family-owned business

* Opportunity to work with a growing automotive parts business

If you have strong automotive parts knowledge and know how to price used parts accurately, competitively and profitably, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We run paid acquisition (Meta) for home-service and local-service businesses.



The role

You own the idea and the words behind our ads. Not the editing, not the media buying — the angle, the hook, the copy, and the read on what worked. You will write, not just brief.



What you'll do

Research each client's ICP (offer, objections, buying triggers, competitor ads) and turn it into 3–5 testable angles per cycle.

Write the full package per concept: hook, primary text, headline, lead-form questions, and calendar/landing page copy.

Write pre-qualifying copy — filtering out tire-kickers is the job, not maximizing raw lead volume.

Brief the video/design team with scripts and reference so they can execute without guesswork.

Read performance weekly (CPL, lead→booked, booked→show) and d
 what to scale, iterate, or kill — with a reason.

Keep our hook/body component library updated so winning ideas get reused, not rediscovered.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years writing direct-response copy for paid social (agency or in-house), with ads you can show us.

Native-level written English and a feel for how North American homeowners/small-business owners actually talk.

Comfort in Meta Ads Manager reporting — you can read a table and form an opinion.

Local-service, home-improvement, or lead-gen experience (strong plus).

Self-direction: we give you the account and the data, not a daily task list.





Not a fit if: you're primarily a designer/editor, you've only written brand or SEO content, or you need a creative director to hand you angles.



At the top of your response to this job post put "Copywriting Creatives & Creative Strategy" so that we know you've read the post.

title: Client Success Manager / Operations Coordinator
description:
The role

You are the single point of contact for our clients and the person who keeps delivery moving internally. Half the job is client success: onboarding, weekly comms, reporting, and keeping accounts happy and renewing. The other half is ops: making sure every client request becomes a tracked task, gets QA'd, launches on time, and nothing goes stale.



What you'll own



Client success (~50%)

Own client relationships end-to-end: onboarding calls, weekly/bi-weekly check-ins, monthly performance reviews.

Translate performance data (leads, appointments kept, cost per kept appointment) into plain-English updates clients actually understand.

Spot churn risk early — slow lead flow, low show rates, quiet clients — and escalate with a fix, not just a flag.

Collect creative assets, offers, approvals and account access without being chased.





Ops / project coordination (~50%)

Run the ClickUp board: every client request becomes a task with owner, due date, and status. No orphan requests.

Traffic the creative → QA → launch → optimization loop; chase blockers and keep QA from becoming a bottleneck.

Own the Slack request pipeline: intake, prioritization, daily standup of what's due, end-of-day recap of what shipped.

Maintain and improve SOPs so the process survives without heroics.

Keep trackers, reporting sheets, and dashboards accurate and current.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years in client success, account management, or agency project coordination (paid media / marketing agency strongly preferred).

Excellent written English — clear, calm, professional under pressure.

Comfort with performance numbers: CPL, show rate, cost per kept appointment. You don't need to build ads, but you must read a report and know what's off.

Hands-on with ClickUp (or Asana/Monday), Slack, Google Sheets; HighLevel and Meta Ads Manager experience is a big plus.

Ruthless follow-through. You close loops without reminders.





Nice to have: experience with home-services or local lead-gen clients, appointment-setting funnels, light copy/creative brief writing.



Success in the first 90 days

Days 1–30: know every client, their offer and their numbers; own the ClickUp board and daily standup.

Days 31–60: run all client comms and monthly reporting independently; QA-to-launch cycle time down measurably.

Days 61–90: zero stale tasks >7 days, no missed client check-ins, documented SOPs for intake → launch → report.





How to apply

Send a short note with: (1) an agency/client-facing role you've held and how many accounts, (2) the PM tool you ran and how
